characters.title: Mistcloak Strike
characters.intro: Aalto is an enigmatic Information Broker, known for his elusive nature and welcoming smile.

characters.title: Magnetism Before Light
characters.intro: Augusta is the undefeated gladiator in the arena and a fearless leader with a will of iron. She is a mere mortal, but has reached heights of glory attempted by only a few, and her blade speaks her power loud and clear.

characters.title: Healing You'tan
characters.intro: Baizhi, a researcher at Huaxu Academy, is known for her sharp intellect and precise methods.

characters.title: Flamebound Compass
characters.intro:
As captain of the Fool's Troupe, Brant exudes a carefree, easygoing charm, unbound by convention. 
Beneath his flamboyant persona lies a genuine heart, deeply devoted to his family and companions. His life is dedicated to securing a safe haven for the Troupe's members

characters.title: Sanguine Blossom
characters.intro: Bloom Bearer from the Black Shores, Camellya is a laid-back character free from shackles, with her personal aroma of "danger." Intrigued by the belief in fate, she wanders the lands of her own accord, following such a chain of scenarios and its vague guidance.

characters.title: Sea of Dreams
characters.intro:
The Fisalia family's thirty-sixth head, Cantarella Fisalia. 
She locks your gaze with eyes as deep as the ocean, where dark tides seem to surge and swirl. 
For a moment, you think you glimpse something in the ocean's depths—but you are unsure if it is the shadow of a giant sea creature... or the tail feathers of the Celestial Steed.

characters.title: Crystal Remorph
characters.intro: Carlotta, the second daughter of the esteemed Montelli family, embodies innate nobility and a refined appreciation for art. Her elegance is matched by her unconventional spirit, unshackled by tradition. To ensure her family’s future, she alternates between dual roles, addressing delicate "troubles" behind the scenes.

characters.title: Feathered Tempest
characters.intro: The powers of the Sentinel and Threnodian clash and unite within her, propelling her into an uncertain future. Whether the future is bright or dim, she will hold the blade firmly and confront all that comes her way.

characters.title: Gallant Blaze
characters.intro: Chixia is a junior Jinzhou Patroller.

characters.title: Woven Melodies
characters.intro:
Ciaccona, the bard of Rinascita, is free-spirited, romantic, sincere, and passionate. 
On her journey, she sang radiant poems of saints and heroes, weaving tales of people, miracles, turmoil, and suffering—along with the sorrow of death and farewell.

characters.title: Wooly–counting Game
characters.intro: Encore, a consultant from the Black Shores, is a quirky, lively, and spunky girl who loves to recount her friendships and adventures through fantasy and fairy tales.

characters.title: Stasis, Cycle, Renewal
characters.intro: Iuno is a Priestess well-known in Septimont for being a prodigy. She is blessed with the infallible ability to see the future by studying how moonlight changes.

characters.title: Thawborn Renewal
characters.intro: Being the Magistrate of Jinzhou, Jinhsi bears her noble and weighty share of duties. Through repeated ages, the Lament has preyed upon mankind's vulnerable hope. Yet, grasping the nettle, she strives with all her might to forge a path toward tomorrow.

characters.title: Windborne Rider
characters.intro: Jiyan is the General of Midnight Rangers stationed in Jinzhou, embracing strong sense of justice and resolution.

characters.title: Kaleido Refraction
characters.intro: From dense forests to vast wilderness, places where navigator of Lollo Logistics Lumi has traveled bear witness to her charming personality, like a shaft of sunlight.

characters.title: Howling Flame
characters.intro: The star gladiator of Septimont, a warrior with a pure heart, untamed spirit, intense passion, and immense potential. She will relentlessly pursue the things she admires, cherishing each moment that allows her to indulge in competition and self-expression on stage.

characters.title: Dragon's Breath
characters.intro: Born into the upper class, Mortefi is a lofty man with an erudite look. Renowned for his exceptional talent in scientific research, Mortefi was once famed as the youngest genius in the New Federation. Driven by a thirst for knowledge, Mortefi later abandoned his privileged life to work as an International Research Fellow at the Huaxu Academy. It's not hard to win Mortefi's favor: Just remember to talk nicely, and always shower him with ample praise.

characters.title: Graceful Luminescence
characters.intro:
Phoebe, an Acolyte of the Order of the Deep, always carries herself with warmth and grace. 
Devout and steadfast in her adherence to the Order's doctrines, she embodies exceptional self-discipline. Yet beneath her composed exterior burns a vibrant spirit, alight with heartfelt joy for all she holds dear.

characters.title: Stage in the Box
characters.intro: Roccia is a gifted improvisational comedian and the First Mate of the Fool's Troupe, known for her mastery of stage props. With a tranquil, composed disposition, she navigates the ship's quarters, perched atop her giant box, meticulously ensuring the Troupe remains orderly and tidy.

characters.title: Snow Waltz
characters.intro: A loyal and reliable guard for Jinhsi, Sanhua is composed and reserved.

characters.title: Euphonic Chrysalis
characters.intro:
The Shorekeeper of the Black Shores, a mysterious divine being governing the essence of aloofness, emerges in response to your summon. 
Having spent eons in guardianship, the first stirrings of emotion and desire awaken within her heart, fostering a firm determination to connect with the world — and with you.

characters.title: Blossom of Slashes
characters.intro: Taoqi oversees Jinzhou's border defense at the Ministry of Development. Despite her unhurried demeanor, she is an exceptionally dependable individual who works tirelessly to protect others and provide a peaceful haven. With effortless efficiency, she balances her work and personal life, steadily moving towards her ultimate goal: creating a future of true safety for all.

characters.title: Breath of Winds
characters.intro: Yangyang journeyed far away from home to become an Outrider in Jinzhou.

characters.title: Cryogenic Wonders
characters.intro: A voluble and whimsical antique appraiser. Known for creating limericks on the spot, she presents her appraisals with flair and precision. She sets up a stall on the street, ensuring antiques find their way to those who truly cherish them.

characters.title: Scorched Radiance
characters.intro:
Zani, a serious and reliable Montelli employee, follows a strict routine and manages tasks with ease. 
For years, she has clocked in on time without fail, finding as much enjoyment in her well-ordered life as in her carefully planned moments of leisure.

voicelines.title: About Encore
voicelines.text: Sometimes not even I can figure out just where Encore's getting all that energy from. As soon as we arrive somewhere, she's off making friends and sharing stories with the local kids in no time. I even got some of my intel from her buddies, believe it or not.

voicelines.title: About Aalto
voicelines.text: Aalto's money this and money that all day, but did you know? Sometimes he helps people for free! He just wouldn't tell me why... Hmph. Then it's up to me to find out!

mentions.title: Favorite Food
mentions.text: Encore's Coral Bowl looks weird, but it sure tastes great.

mentions.title: A Perfect Duo
mentions.text: Encore will get it done real quick, as long as Aalto doesn’t drag behind me!” Encore, you broke my heart.

mentions.title: A Free Service
mentions.text: At least, that’s how Encore saw it. As today’s story came to an end, Encore couldn’t help but ask, “I didn’t know you’d help people for free!”

mentions.title: Thoughts: II
mentions.text: Aalto and the others won't ever let me go near.

mentions.title: Favorite Food
mentions.text: Psst, It's a little trade secret I got from Aalto!

mentions.title: About Verina
mentions.text: But some of them looked a bit wacky, like the one that gobbled down on Aalto's head and gave him a new haircut…

voicelines.title: About Jiyan
voicelines.text: Being the Jinzhou Garrison's General is no walk in the park. You gotta have that big-picture thinking, be on top of everything, and make decisions like they're nothing. Just take a look at General Jiyan—he's got all those boxes checked off and then some.

voicelines.title: About Aalto
voicelines.text: Fog can be an enemy to soldiers on the march, as it limits visibility and complicates situational awareness. However, deploying fog strategically can be an effective move on the battlefield. I have had the opportunity to work with Aalto before, and he is an interesting person indeed.

mentions.title: About Encore
mentions.text: Are you referring to the little girl who is always seen by Aalto's side?

voicelines.title: About Chixia
voicelines.text: Oh, Miss Chixia. Our first convo didn't go quite as planned. I was doing some business in Jinzhou at the time, then she tried to arrest me, probably thought I was some crook. Lucky for me we worked it out later.

voicelines.title: About Yangyang
voicelines.text: Miss Yangyang? We haven't talked much, but the way she can tap into the "Streams" for intel is definitely something. As someone in the information game, that really sounds handy. I should see if she's interested in being my informant.

bonds.label: Know of each other

voicelines.title: About Baizhi
voicelines.text: Hmm… Seems unlikely she'll ever be my client. She's the type of person to trust the conclusions from her own research over information provided by anyone else.

bonds.label: Know of each other

voicelines.title: About Mortefi
voicelines.text: The Academy's red-haired international research fellow? I heard he's got a way of handling difficult clients. Actually... I was thinking about asking him for some pointers.

sceneQuests: Depths of Illusive Realm · event story

voicelines.title: About Calcharo
voicelines.text: I always enjoy doing business with a Ghost Hound. They keep things clean, They're straightforward, and they don't goof around.

voicelines.title: About Aalto
voicelines.text: Need to reach Aalto? Here's his contact. Mention my name for a twenty percent discount.

bonds.label: Know of each other

voicelines.title: About Verina
voicelines.text: That little girl from Rigg's Explorers? Yeah, I bumped into her once, back in the New Federation. Offered me a Starflower for the whereabouts of her mother. But the deal fell through, because she didn't have what I was asking for. And what was that, you ask? Well… I asked for a never-withering flower. In reply, she told me plants have their life cycle, and wilting is just a natural part of it. I remember telling her, "The same can be said for humans."

quests.quest: So as the Melting Snow Desires

mentions.title: Every Unspoken Word
mentions.text: Tomorrow, she and Rover would stand before the Exostrider. Rover looked happy.

mentions.title: The Star That Voyages Far
mentions.text: (Is this Aemeath's old dorm? Since she can resonate with the Exostrider, even after her body was destroyed, her frequency must have merged with it.)

mentions.title: Starlights from Yesterdays
mentions.text: (Back at the fan meeting… people mentioned a Sakya. They said she was Aemeath's teacher. That she actually really cared.)

mentions.title: All That Sunlight Touches
mentions.text: I trust Aemeath. What we experienced together proved she was telling me the truth. And there's a connection there I can't ignore.

mentions.title: The Wind Before the Storm
mentions.text: Aemeath, are you still set on walking the "savior's" path?

mentions.title: Gold Suspended in Shadows
mentions.text: Aemeath...

voicelines.title: About Iuno
voicelines.text: Iuno and I became friends because we're so alike—stubborn, headstrong, and relentless in the face of defeat. In many ways, we walked in each other's footsteps, each unwilling to fall behind, and so we ended up on the same path. Even so, there are times I wish she could live more freely. I know the pain she carries runs deeper than what she's ever told me. To others, she may seem arrogant or willful, but that defiance stems from her certainty that every step she takes must be the right one. And such certainty… always demands a price.

voicelines.title: About Augusta
voicelines.text: Here's a little secret even Augusta doesn't know. When we first met, I told her she'd lead Septimont into a new era, and she believed it to be one of my prophecies. But really, it was just a hunch. I never peep into her fate because it's always been in her hands. She's the kind of ruler who'd sacrifice everything for her people, even her own flesh and blood. You don't need a coronation to see that. It's obvious at a glance. Yet, that kind of responsibility she carries is heavier than anyone else can imagine. Even though I know she can handle it alone, I still want to help somehow. As a Priestess, as a friend... or even as someone she has forgotten.

mentions.title: Favorite Food
mentions.text: Iuno always says my choice in food leaves much to be desired.

mentions.title: By Sun's Burning Hand
mentions.text: It all started when Augusta shook things up the moment she became Ephor. Especially in rooting out corruption within the Gladiator's Agon while ignoring the senators in the process.

mentions.title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
mentions.text: It doesn't make sense. The Earthrend Wedge is still holding back the Dark Tide at its depths... At any rate, Augusta's already led a team to the Sanguis Plateaus to investigate.

mentions.title: By Moon's Fated Light
mentions.text: Did something happen in Septimont? Is it Augusta or the others? No, that's impossible... I should've disappeared by now. Why do I feel so tired? Like I'm walking the same path, over and over again without end...

mentions.title: Shadow of Glory
mentions.text: Augusta, look! Another two have earned Arsinosa's blessing.

mentions.title: Rust, Sword and the Sun
mentions.text: You're overthinking it, Augusta. I'm here to see that person.

voicelines.title: About Avidius
voicelines.text: A formidable opponent. His words and actions have indeed earned the Senate's favor. I'm well aware the Senate is far from clean, but I trust Avidius has no intention of sinking into its filth. What I do wonder, though, is how fiercely his ambition will burn… or whether the confusion I now see in his eyes will one day consume him, leaving only cold embers in the wake of a fire gone out.

mentions.title: By Sun's Burning Hand
mentions.text: I assure you, Priestess, I will not act from the shadows. If Augusta seeks a fair challenge, I shall honor her with the respect she deserves.

mentions.title: By Moon's Fated Light
mentions.text: I always thought I was the hero who conquered Manes Deep. The one more worthy of ruling than even Augusta.

mentions.title: By Sun's Burning Hand
mentions.text: Avidius, descendant of the Hero of Heroes, Atilius. Decorated for the four crossings of Manes Deep.

voicelines.title: About Lupa
voicelines.text: A genius made for the arena whose passion burns pure. Had we met in the early days of the Colosseum, perhaps we would have fought side by side, as you two do now. Just watching her reminds me that my efforts to reform the arena were not in vain. The Colosseum is always meant to be a stage for passion and glory, not a mire of corruption and decay.

voicelines.title: About Augusta
voicelines.text: Whenever I watch videos of the Ephor's past fights, I do wonder if she stepped into the arena for political reasons, or-or to prove herself. Whatever her reason, Augusta's rise to power was a good thing for Septimont. Change is always toughest at the beginning. And for that, I have respect for her.

mentions.title: Shadow of Glory
mentions.text: Ephor Augusta's are the most popular. Four years ago, she became the champion and a household name by crushing every single opponent. From there, she worked her way up into the Ephor's seat.

voicelines.title: About Buling
voicelines.text: Buling... Heh, just from the name alone, I can tell she's from Huanglong. From the moment we met, this remarkable young lady made an impression. I'm grateful she kept her promise and gave Septimont a fighting chance. For me, and for everyone in this land, her kindness is a debt we will never forget.

mentions.title: By Sun's Burning Hand
mentions.text: Buling mentioned even something small could have a great influence. The smaller, the more unnoticed.

voicelines.title: About Angel
voicelines.text: Angel... I've never forgotten Fabianum, nor the past we shared. When our homeland fell... I don't know what kind of nightmare she faced that day in the depths of Oak Hollow. But there is a voice in my heart that never fades... it tells me she's still alive. And I believe, one day, Angel will find her way home, back to our land.

voicelines.title: About Augusta
voicelines.text: Augusta... she was my childhood friend. Back then, I'd usually sit quietly under a tree, lost in my own thoughts. She'd be off swinging her sword, shouting about becoming the next Hero of Heroes. She loved dragging me into sparring matches... We'd often end up scuffling into the Fabianum rivers, and when we got tired, we'd lie on the riverbank letting the cool water soak us completely. Now... time has changed a lot. But thankfully, not all of it for the worse. Augusta became exactly the kind of ruler Septimont needed.

mentions.title: Of a Childhood Long Gone
mentions.text: The girl, Augusta, cared most for the stories behind each weapon, while Angel was captivated by the mysterious ritual of "quenching."

mentions.title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
mentions.text: Augusta, you buried the "Waystone" yourself. But it's been corrupted. Only the Sentinel's power can purifv it.

voicelines.title: About Yangyang
voicelines.text: Some people are good at listening, while some are good at counseling others. Yangyang is good at both. With her, you can just be yourself.

voicelines.title: About Baizhi
voicelines.text: Baizhi has a unique approach to comprehending and accomplishing tasks, but that doesn't make her a difficult person to talk to. When you ask her for help, you may notice a flicker of surprise on her face, but you will never receive a refusal.

mentions.title: First Resonance
mentions.text: He might be able to help us get in touch with Baizhi, but, erm... it seems we've caught him at a bad time.

mentions.title: Utterance of Marvels: I
mentions.text: Baizhi is just concerned about your condition. She must think we shouldn't be letting you move around that much, since you've just regained consciousness...

mentions.title: A New Companion
mentions.text: So, the excess energy this little thing had "consumed" somehow ended up in your body, available at your disposal. In other words, there's a deeper connection between the two of you. Or, according to Baizhi, it’s a Convergent Codependency.

mentions.title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
mentions.text: My voicemail is... wait. Ninety-nine missed calls?! Baizhi, Zhezhi, Taoqi, Suisui, Jianxin... even Magistrate Jinhsi called!

mentions.title: Echoing Marche
mentions.text: Baizhi said the leaf bears the frequencies of Tacet Discords, so it must be from a tree near a Tacet Field.

mentions.title: Utterance of Marvels: II
mentions.text: Baizhi, I think your last sentence could be worded better...

quests.quest: Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song

voicelines.title: About Chixia
voicelines.text: When I first met Chixia, I was indeed a bit overwhelmed... She was always vibrant and lively, and her way of thinking was very different from mine. As our understanding of each other grew, we created a unique synergy. Our differences complemented each other perfectly.

voicelines.title: About Baizhi
voicelines.text: Speaking of Baizhi, she's not the talkative type. Don't get me wrong, she's not an Ice Queen! She just has her own ways of expressing emotions. You'll get it once you've spent enough time with her.

mentions.title: Utterance of Marvels: I
mentions.text: Ugh, I knew it. Our gourds are out of service because of the Etheric Sea's influence. We can't send or receive messages for help now. We better hurry over to meet up with Baizhi at our gathering spot and get outta here.

mentions.title: First Resonance
mentions.text: I'd love me some Chili Sauce Tofu, Jinzhou Maocai, Spicy Meat Slices... Ugh, I'm starving. Wait a sec, we still need to meet up with Baizhi first, right?

mentions.title: A New Companion
mentions.text: Knew it. Nothing about Rover's ever gonna be easy to figure out... Hmm. Maybe we should bring Baizhi, Mr. Xiangli Yao, and all the researchers in Jinzhou... No, in the entire Huanglong together. They'll do a nice and thorough examination on Abby, and then...

mentions.title: Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song
mentions.text: Seriously? What a pity... Okay then, I'll tell Yangyang and Baizhi you can't make it to the show...

mentions.title: Echoing Marche
mentions.text: And with just a few tugs of the rope, I bet every researcher will come running at you, with Baizhi leading the pack. Hook, line, and sinker!

mentions.title: Rewinding Raindrops
mentions.text: It's just Baizhi being Baizhi. She's a little awkward with showing care, but I think it's cute!

bonds.label: Acquainted

voicelines.title: About Mortefi
voicelines.text: We didn't converse frequently, but our cooperation was always seamless. He may experience minor inflammation-related health issues because of his Resonance Ability, so I suggest bringing him Bittberry tea next time. A single cup can relieve his symptoms for a whole day.

voicelines.title: About Baizhi
voicelines.text: Baizhi and I are almost colleagues, though we don't work in the same department. I've only interacted with her briefly on a few occasions, but I had the chance to read some of her writings. Her paper was well-thought-out and carefully expressed, featuring an intriguing perspective. If I may comment, she is an excellent scholar of Remnant Creatures.

mentions.title: First Resonance
mentions.text: Ms. Baizhi. As a Huanglong local working at the Academy, I suppose you already had an idea about what it is?

mentions.title: Grand Warstorm
mentions.text: Lastly, we've got more bad news... Baizhi, please fill us in.

mentions.title: Pastures like old times
mentions.text: It's someone you know. Baizhi. She specializes in Ecoacoustic research, and the Sonoro Sphere is her field of expertise.

mentions.title: Unsettled Aftermath (I)
mentions.text: Baizhi mentioned you came into contact with a substantial amount of Autopuppets in Xuanfang Hold. I'd like to hear about them. The more detail, the better.

mentions.title: First Resonance
mentions.text: Yes, Mortefi is the Branch of Tacetite Weaponry's head within the Department of Safety.

sceneQuests: Depths of Illusive Realm · event story

bonds.label: Acquainted

voicelines.title: About Xiangli Yao
voicelines.text: His good temper is almost as impressive as the exceptional talent he has. I've never seen him raise his voice in anger at anyone. No matter how impossible the task sounds, he always delivers.

voicelines.title: About Baizhi
voicelines.text: Baizhi is a great researcher. Our work doesn't often overlap, but I've read her reports and they're well-informed and persuasive. She often participates in field research, earning her a reputation among peers for bringing back valuable data.

mentions.title: Wish Upon the Moon II: The Elder's Promise
mentions.text: So that's what you're worried about. It seems what Baizhi said about you is true. You do have a gentle soul.

mentions.title: The Wind Before the Storm
mentions.text: That's right, Baizhi. Without you, Chixia's condition wouldn't have stabilized so quickly. And frankly, she might've been left with permanent damage.

sceneQuests: Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song

voicelines.title: About Yuanwu
voicelines.text: The tea Mr. Yuanwu brews always tastes sweeter than those served in teahouses, even if the same recipe and ingredients were used. He told me it was only because he put his sincerity into it. Sincerity... How does it affect the flavor of tea?

mentions.text: First, he bought a pizza from Margherita's, then made a bet with the pigeons in the square.

mentions.text: Margherita, two glasses of Nectarwine please, and top off Bella's drink. On my tab.

quests.quest: What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing

voicelines.title: About Roccia
voicelines.text: Don't be fooled by our First Mate's age—if you ever need performance advice, she's your go-to. Plus, she's also an excellent stage designer!

voicelines.title: About Brant
voicelines.text: Brant is the greatest captain in all of Solaris. At least, that's what he insists I say. But it's true, having him around really does bring out the best in us. His passion is infectious, and his belief in freedom is like the mast that keeps us all steady.

mentions.title: Dusk, When Fools Sing
mentions.text: Battier hauled in a bountiful catch of fish, Lavito returned with a bundle of hares from his hunt, and Roccia, with her loyal companion Pero, returned with a basket of meat they'd bought with one of the bounties earned in the name of Captain Brant. Battier and Lavito were deep in a heated debate, Hymer and Budd were playing rock-paper-scissors, and Tina was coaching Roccia on breathing techniques for singing.

mentions.title: Peculiar Box
mentions.text: Tina's bright voice rang out, Bardolino flew in the air with balloons and tossed petals, Brant swung down on a rope holding a massive welcome banner, and Pero fired the confetti pistol, inviting her to the stage.

mentions.title: New Stage
mentions.text: "Brant the Maverick Captain," and "Pero the Peculiar Box" became legends of their own. Childhood memories were hazy for Roccia, but as she followed Brant and the crew into Ragunna's streets, the familiar smell of Trattoria Margherita's fresh-baked pizza and the songs spilling from the Odyssey Opera House stirred something deep within her, just like it did everyone else.

mentions.title: Through the Sea Thou Break
mentions.text: All good, Roccia? Some new friends have joined us.

mentions.title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
mentions.text: But you're a bit too young for this, Roccia. The crew and I will handle the taste test!

mentions.title: All Out! Towards the Peaks of Prestige (Quest)
mentions.text: Of course not! Came with the whole Troupe. But Roccia's busy with prepping a show with the others and said they didn't need me hanging around.

quests.quest: What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing

voicelines.title: About Carlotta
voicelines.text: She's got her course set and sticks to it, no matter what. Living as a Montelli is no easy path, but she's determined to make her own way. And mark my words, when her performances draw to a close, she'll be known not just as a Montelli, but Carlotta.

voicelines.title: About Brant
voicelines.text: He's the captain leading his crew through tempestuous seas, and I often wonder whether his gaze from the deck reveals ambition, or selflessness and passion. Our family once extended an invitation to him, but he declined, remarking, "A captain's ship is his alone, and he will never abandon it." Thus, we remain partners with aligned interests, and that suits us just fine.

mentions.title: What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing
mentions.text: If you're ready, let's begin! Everyone, a big round of applause to welcome the Rover and Ms. Carlotta on stage!

mentions.title: What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing
mentions.text: I have sent the address to your Terminal. Brant and Roccia are also here. We are awaiting your arrival.

bonds.label: Acquainted

voicelines.title: About Cartethyia
voicelines.text: Some call her a saint; others, a sinner. But who is she really? No one cares how she treats her friends or faces her foes. The Order's tales never speak of her dreams, and the legends conceal her heart's desire. Everyone has heard of Cartethyia—but does anyone know the person behind that name?

sceneQuests: What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing

bonds.label: Acquainted

voicelines.title: About Zani
voicelines.text: Many wear masks to fit in, but not her. Whatever her past, whatever roles she's played, she's here now, true to herself.

voicelines.title: About Brant
voicelines.text: Brant is a skilled actor, a respected captain, and a fighter willing to sacrifice everything for truth and justice. But what I envy most is that he's never weighed down by stacks of paperwork. If I knew anything about acting, I'd quit this job, join the Troupe of Fools, and live the carefree life he does... Now, now. Just a pipe dream to keep me going.

sceneQuests: What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing

voicelines.title: About Jianxin
voicelines.text: She's the same as me, super good at some stuff, bad at others. Last martial contest, Master Shiling said she punches too much, thinks too little. I wanted to challenge her—but whoosh—her palm wind came out of nowhere and blew right through my spell array and talisman! But it's okay. I'm not the fist-and-muscle type. Redirecting force to attack is the smarter move. Hehe, knowing Jianxin's style, next time I might not even need to lift a finger. Just a bit of smooth talk and walk away with the win...?

mentions.title: Peers of Different Sects
mentions.text: "Ah, I heard that the Fengyiquan Sect is full of talent, and Jianxin is undoubtedly unmatched. On the ring, Buling and Jianxin faced each other.

mentions.title: Shadow of Glory
mentions.text: Heard about you from an old friend. You know Jianxin? Pretty sure you met her in Jinzhou. She trained with the same master before me.

voicelines.title: About Youhu
voicelines.text: Master Youhu helps lots of my clients check their treasures, telling them what's real, what's fake, clearing their doubts and worries. But she's never that serious with me. Last time she brought out a new eggshell porcelain cup. Told me it's an ancient treasure with thin glaze, clean color, things like that, and she said five hundred Shell Credits is a steal. I said the cup was cursed with evil Yin Qi, and better pay seven hundred for a talisman seal, or it's not safe. Guess what happened in the end?

voicelines.title: About Aalto
voicelines.text: We haven't met many times, but somehow, he feels like an old friend. Why? I thought I knew many people from traveling, but he knows even more! No matter where I go, someone always drops his name. What's that theory… any two people in the world are only like, six degrees apart? I bet we show up in the same friend circles all the time.

mentions.title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
mentions.text: So, all available Bloom Bearers have arrived in Rinascita. We're standing guard at Averardo Vault, and Buling is already en route to reinforce Septimont.

voicelines.title: About Camellya
voicelines.text: She's... an interesting one. Before I joined the Black Shores, she tried to fight me. Of course I was no match for her, so I ran for it, as fast as oil on shoes! But she chased me all the way... into the Tacet Discord nest I led her to. She got caught up fighting, looked up and smiled at me. I was sitting in a tree, smiling right back. It was interesting... real interesting.

mentions.title: Earthly Immortal, Heavenly Sheep
mentions.text: Back then, she had just passed Camellya's test and arrived at the Black Shores archipelago for the first time as a Consultant.

voicelines.title: About Encore
voicelines.text: Every time I go chasing ghost rumors, I always ask Encore to come along. She's not scared and she loves a new adventure! Sometimes she even livestreams it on the forum, makes up spooky stories to reel our audience in. Then when we drop the twist there's no ghost, we hide behind the screen and laugh till our bellies hurt. Then? Poof. Delete account. Hey, you want to know our forum nicknames? I'm "Earthly Immortal," and she's "Heavenly Sheep."

mentions.title: Earthly Immortal, Heavenly Sheep
mentions.text: Buling made friends with Encore on an unexpected occasion. Encore poked her head out from behind the plush toys, grinning.

voicelines.title: About Shorekeeper
voicelines.text: She stands guard, outside all laws, all patterns... But total detatchment from the world isn't always a good thing. That isn't my divination, I can't read her. But I see it, loud and clear.

mentions.title: Flowing Starlight in the Iris
mentions.text: From the guest list you provided, only Encore, Buling, and myself were free to come. The others are either away or currently on assignment.

mentions.title: The Patroller and the Taoist
mentions.text: Chixia, Jinzhou Patroller!" Chixia straightened with pride at being recognized, then quickly regained her serious tone.

mentions.title: Free Spirit in Travel
mentions.text: That Rover was different—no carefree traveler, but someone forever running from one storm to the next.

mentions.title: Shadow of Glory
mentions.text: How much do you know about it? This is our second time meeting, Buling. That can't be a coincidence.

mentions.title: By Sun's Burning Hand
mentions.text: If anyone can sniff out the truth, it's Abby. But just to be sure, I'll send the data to Buling once we're out of here.

mentions.title: Flames of Heart
mentions.text: (Before meeting Buling, when I touched the Echo in that village, I felt... a layered, indistinct frequency.)

mentions.title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
mentions.text: Buling's bronze mirror isn't responding... Abby?

voicelines.title: About Jiyan
voicelines.text: He's a capable leader. He once recommended me an ancient tome on the art of war from Huanglong, one that I regret not acquiring sooner—it could have saved me some effort. As for the deal between us... *scoff* It was merely an exchange of interests. Nothing more.

mentions.title: Domestication
mentions.text: Because of reasons unspecified, Calcharo stumbled upon Jiyan's troops inside the borders of Huanglong. After careful consideration, Jiyan accepted this mutually beneficial deal.

voicelines.title: About Mortefi
voicelines.text: Pretentious, arrogant, and self-absorbed... That man epitomizes every trait associated with those snooty New Federation nobles. That said, I cannot deny his talent in crafting Tacetite Weapons. I can arrange a meeting with our trusted arms dealer, if he's interested.

voicelines.title: About Yinlin
voicelines.text: Yinlin? That undercover agent who infiltrated my group? *huff* Easy there. I didn't give her a hard time, provided she always stayed in her lane.

voicelines.title: About Verina
voicelines.text: I met her once. A prodigy in the field of botany at such a young age... Impressive.

voicelines.title: About Calcharo
voicelines.text: I remember meeting Mr. Calcharo when I was out collecting data in the wild. At first, he didn't seem very approachable... but then he gave me some flower seeds, all super rare species. He's so awesome.

voicelines.title: About Encore
voicelines.text: Encore… Ah, that girl who loves stories! I hope she'll mature into a strong opponent one day, then we'll have so much fun together.

voicelines.title: About Shorekeeper
voicelines.text: She's always so serious, following every rule despite being our de facto leader now. Well, she's taken care of me before on many occasions, so I gotta show some respect... Wait, I've been a Bloom Bearer for years? How time flies…

voicelines.title: About Camellya
voicelines.text: Though her words may not always align with her actions, she remains fiercely loyal to her desires. Her carefree lifestyle holds a certain charm, yes, but we were made differently, with distinct objectives to pursue. Following your example, I've allowed her to make her own choices, without limitations.

mentions.title: About Jinhsi
mentions.text: The Loong Maiden of Jinzhou reminds me of the Shorekeeper, the way they're oh-so-devoted to their duties, all the self-sacrifice!

mentions.title: The One that Impresses
mentions.text: Abbowser... is the new leader of the New Black Shores? And Camellya joined Abbowser? Or... did Abbowser's minions join Camellya?

mentions.title: The One that Impresses
mentions.text: Giving up already? Even Shorekeeper hasn't had her fill yet.

voicelines.title: About Aalto
voicelines.text: Aalto's a master at mind games. It's hard to get under his skin! He's not strong enough to pique my interest though. That guy relies on trickery too much for my liking.

mentions.title: Rewinding Raindrops
mentions.text: Camellya? Course we do!

mentions.title: Through the Sea Thou Break
mentions.text: Encore's off on a mission! Camellya's out too! Yelling's not gonna save you!

voicelines.title: About Jinhsi
voicelines.text: The Loong Maiden of Jinzhou reminds me of the Shorekeeper, the way they're oh-so-devoted to their duties, all the self-sacrifice! I don't understand, why must they burden themselves so much?

voicelines.title: About Jianxin
voicelines.text: That girl, the Taoist? She's a fun one to watch. She may seem to follow human society's boring norms, but her untamed spirit still shines through every now and then.

mentions.title: To the Days Ahead
mentions.text: She knew Rover was to remain in the Black Shores, preparing for journey to Rinascita. She gave Rover a gift, a bracelet designed to monitor frequencies, just like the one they had given her before.

mentions.title: A Fleeting Moment
mentions.text: Most of the time, she opted to accompany Rover on various errands, leaving her footprints across the tapestry of Solaris, from bustling towns to unknown alcoves, safe havens to treacherous lands. Lady Flora relished this existence, brimming with the thrill of the unknown, and Rover had an uncanny talent for transforming the ordinary into something extraordinary.

mentions.title: Eve
mentions.text: A void of chaos swirled within her, yet there was one thing that stood out in sharp relief: Rover. Who she was, who Rover is, the reason for her being, Solaris, and the Lament…

mentions.title: Once Upon a Time
mentions.text: It was a song she had learned from Rover. Of course, she hadn't heard it directly from Rover , she had picked it up secretly.

mentions.title: Dreamscape Odyssey: Blooming Reverie
mentions.text: Is that... Camellya? She needs help.

bonds.label: Acquainted

voicelines.title: About Carlotta
voicelines.text: Even in shackles, she dances elegantly—a true Montelli, yet more than that. Where will her choices lead her family? How delightful to imagine how she might present herself when next we meet.

mentions.title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
mentions.text: Members of Fisalia will relocate to Averardo Vault. When I meet with Carlotta and the others, I'll relay what we've learned about Leviathan.

mentions.title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
mentions.text: We've lost contact with Cantarella. The Beacon on her end appears to have been destroyed.

voicelines.title: About Roccia
voicelines.text: The little girl with a giant box who plays with fireworks? A fascinating child. I wonder if bringing her into this castle would liven it up a little. Oh relax, I'm only teasing.

quests.quest: The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier

voicelines.title: About Cartethyia
voicelines.text: She accomplished the impossible, reclaiming her humanity from the cage of a Divinity's vessel. When the Carnevale petals fall upon Ragunna's streets again, the Holy Maiden will at last be herself.

voicelines.title: About Cantarella
voicelines.text: I… took away the brilliant future she was meant to have. The future of being the Sentinel's true Blessed Maiden. All the goodwill and hopes placed upon me, and the power I now possess… all of it should have belonged to Cantarella. Yet, she never seemed bothered by it. Someone as mature as her must have already found her own path within the Fisalia family. But still, I'll always remember that I owe her so much… so much.

mentions.title: The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier
mentions.text: Precisely. It could very well have been Cartethyia's doing. But, as with the first time, there's also the chance it was the Sentinel who turned the tide.

mentions.title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
mentions.text: Cartethyia remains secure in the Fisalia estate. But the Divinity's statue began whispering in our minds... Then came the Tidespawn soon after.

mentions.title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
mentions.text: Galbrena and Cartethyia hesitated to reveal their full plan... and perhaps this is why. As she said, only an unshakable will can stand against Leviathan.

mentions.title: Shadow of Glory
mentions.text: Cartethyia is missing… I see.

mentions.title: The One that Impresses
mentions.text: Cartethyia, do kindly cast your gaze upon me, Rover, and MR. "Most Powerful Resonator" over there. Have you noticed our smiles?

mentions.title: The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier
mentions.text: One last thing, you should speak with Cantarella. I can sense she made it out of Sonoro Sphere, safely.

bonds.label: Acquainted

quests.quest: The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier

voicelines.title: About Rover
voicelines.text: Hmm, what would be a fitting analogy... perhaps an immortal jellyfish? Like these delicate, shimmering creatures roving alone in the darkness, dispels shadows with gentle light, inch by inch, until the end of time.

mentions.title: Lucid Dream
mentions.text: This quiet, tranquil afternoon was a miracle granted by no other but Rover.

mentions.title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
mentions.text: ...Cantarella, you never did get to say what brought you here.

mentions.title: The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier
mentions.text: (Cantarella said that only those who resonate with Tyrvine are granted glimpses of its knowledge...)

mentions.title: Shadow of Glory
mentions.text: Sounds like the perfect time to visit Septimont. Thank you, Cantarella.

mentions.title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
mentions.text: Cantarella went inside to prepare that "antidote"... She should be finished now. Time to find her.

mentions.title: A Fleeting Night's Dream
mentions.text: Cantarella, since you were part of the trials yourself, why not just tell me the secret?

voicelines.title: About Roccia
voicelines.text: I've always been curious about something. Just how much can her box, Pero, actually hold? New designs, costumes, the fine wines the troupe keeps hidden, shimmering sea gems and shells... And Roccia's thoughts and feelings, too. Though Roccia herself rarely speaks her mind, Pero seems to reveal them all.

voicelines.title: About Carlotta
voicelines.text: Leading a large family is like steering a massive ship. It requires immense effort to keep it on course. I have firsthand experience in managing a vessel, and I admire her energy and bravery in navigating this journey.

mentions.title: What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing
mentions.text: We don't know what challenges we'll face, so your help will be needed, Ms. Carlotta. Plus, it's a chance for you to get to know our methods.

mentions.title: Veils Off in Sun or Shadow
mentions.text: We were supposed to pick you up like Ms. Carlotta planned, but... things went sideways.

mentions.title: What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing
mentions.text: I have sent the address to your Terminal. Brant and Roccia are also here. We are awaiting your arrival.

sceneQuests: Veils Off in Sun or Shadow

voicelines.title: About Phoebe
voicelines.text: Phoebe is as pure and innocent as a budding lily. Her kindness and devotion are beyond question. Yet, without sufficient strength, such virtues might lead one into the trap of blind faith. I mean no disrespect, but this is a dilemma every believer faces at some point—whether they are following a mere illusion shaped by others' agendas or upholding principles and beliefs that truly have meaning.

mentions.title: What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing
mentions.text: We contacted the Acolyte, Phoebe. After some digging in the Order's records, she confirmed that before taking on her holy title, the Blessed Fleurdelys was called... Cartethyia.

mentions.title: The One that Impresses
mentions.text: Hehe, Primus Phoebe... Now, that sounds like a wonderful investment!

mentions.title: The One that Impresses
mentions.text: Rover? And Lady Carlotta? W-why are you here?! P-please don't misunderstand me, I'm not...

sceneQuests: A Stranger in a Strange Land

voicelines.title: About Zani
voicelines.text: Zani is wary of unnecessary, inefficient tasks because she excels at completing her work with haste, precision, and quality. Although it may seem that these aspects contradict each other, they actually complement one another. The family imposes few restrictions on private commissions, so if you have a challenging request, feel free to approach her. Oh, but do ensure the compensation is appropriate.

voicelines.title: About Carlotta
voicelines.text: Lady Carlotta? Her vision has never been limited to Ragunna, or even Rinascita. Hers was about the world beyond the sea horizon. I don't know what kind of future she sees, but I'll stand by her until the day her vision becomes reality.

mentions.title: Veils Off in Sun or Shadow
mentions.text: We're done here. Let the guards take care of the rest. So, Ms. Zani mentioned you heard the Sentinel's oracle when you met the Vitreum Dancer?

mentions.title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
mentions.text: ...Very well. We'll hold the line. Zani, call in the family's transport Echoes. We'll assist Rover where we can.

mentions.title: What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing
mentions.text: We are lucky that you and Zani, along with that Acolyte, awakened Lorelei in time. You prevented the mist from spreading and averted the Waveworn. The Fractsidus must still be licking their wounds.

mentions.title: The One that Impresses
mentions.text: If I were to help you clear your debts and find a way to make Abbowser forgive you, would you consider working for the family again, Zani?

mentions.title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
mentions.text: Lady Carlotta, we still face a significant shortage of supplies. The Black Shores have met some urgent demands, but moving forward...

mentions.title: Veils Off in Sun or Shadow
mentions.text: Oh, you're back. I've done everything you asked, Lady Carlotta. All the thugs trying to storm the room were handled.

mentions.title: In the Name of Carlotta
mentions.text: After celebrating the Carnevale with the distinguished guest, and exposing Capollo's betrayal with their (Rover) help, Carlotta finally understood what Grandfather had been unable to fully express on that rainy night. But perhaps Rover would be the exception.

mentions.title: Veils Off in Sun or Shadow
mentions.text: Carlotta, hello?!

mentions.title: The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier
mentions.text: Carlotta once helped me interpret some stained glass images. The story it told was very similar to what you've described.

mentions.title: What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing
mentions.text: And the Fisalia family worships the Threnodian. We'll have to wait for Carlotta to arrange an audience with them.

mentions.title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
mentions.text: But I saw Carlotta, Brant, everyone... and you. You were all just like in that illusion I had before...

mentions.title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
mentions.text: Those voices... Zani and Carlotta?

sceneQuests: A Stranger in a Strange Land
The Sacred Breeze So Often Breathes

bonds.label: Acquainted

voicelines.title: About Phoebe
voicelines.text: That girl has a kind and gentle heart. Duties aside, she always does her best to be there for others. Honestly, when it comes to knowledge of the Order's doctrines, I'm nowhere near as good as Phoebe. It's because of so many true and faithful believers like her, I find it difficult to reveal the truth to the people of Ragunna. People turn to faith for many reasons, not just out of devotion to the Sentinel. To unveil such unsettling truths would bring forth countless difficult choices and challenges...

voicelines.title: About Cartethyia
voicelines.text: ...I once dreamt of a black sea, with swells growing larger and more violent. Amidst the spray, the Blessed Maiden appeared—or at least I think it was her. Something in that swaying silhouette resembled her, yet it also felt so unlike her...

mentions.title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
mentions.text: Phoebe, your faith in the Sentinel has never wavered, nor has it been blind. It stems not from obedience, but from a deep belief in Their deeds and ideals.

mentions.title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
mentions.text: Are you considering running, Cartethyia?

sceneQuests: What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing

bonds.label: Acquainted
