voicelines.title: About Carlotta
voicelines.text: As the daughter of Montelli, she has really brought fresh ideas to the city. If this island were to stay isolated, the air would grow stifling. The people of Ragunna need new ships, new horizons, and new discoveries. I'm not very skilled in business matters, though. My nanny in the Order always said I didn't even know how to haggle... If I ever get the chance, I'd love to learn a few tricks from Miss Carlotta!

mentions.title: What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing
mentions.text: We contacted the Acolyte, Phoebe. After some digging in the Order's records, she confirmed that before taking on her holy title, the Blessed Fleurdelys was called... Cartethyia.

mentions.title: The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier
mentions.text: In the meantime, I'll keep looking for more information and the person Cartethyia mentioned to you.

sceneQuests: The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier

bonds.label: Know of each other

voicelines.title: About Ciaccona
voicelines.text: When I was a child, I used to beg the bards passing through town to sing me stories of knights. After I was freed from the tower, I wandered through a field one day, and the wind carried a piece of beautiful music to me. I stood beneath a tree in the distance, listening as Ciaccona sang a new poem, one with the melody of Egla Town's folk songs… In the blink of an eye, noon had already given way to dusk.

voicelines.title: About Cartethyia
voicelines.text: The Blessed Maiden? Or a villain? There are still many unanswered questions in Cartethyia's story. I would never sing an incomplete story. A tale must have a proper ending for a bard to make it truly resonate through history.

mentions.title: The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier
mentions.text: Well, it's a little tricky to explain in words... Think of it like being in an immersive portrait. Can you tell me about your meeting with Cartethyia?

mentions.title: A Stranger in a Strange Land
mentions.text: It's similar to what happened when I helped you see Cartethyia.

sceneQuests: The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier

bonds.label: Acquainted

voicelines.title: About Lupa
voicelines.text: The nature of the Threnodian's power to converge often makes me appear dangerous and unsettling after battle, but Lupa has never once recoiled. She never treats me as more or less than I am, and she has never distanced herself. She is honest, tenacious, and unwavering in her care of her friends. Even though I'm shorter than her when not in my Fleurdelys form, I still feel that I should take on the role of the "older sister" in our friendship.

voicelines.title: About Cartethyia
voicelines.text: In that empty city, Cartethyia was there for me during my most delirious and painful moments. At first, our conversations were a bit stiff. Guess she hadn't spoken to anyone in who knows how long. But as we spent more time together, I realized that she was actually easygoing and carefree. For someone like her, being trapped in one place for so long must've been unbearable... Now that our long journey is over, I hope my friend can fully enjoy this moment of peace.

mentions.title: Thoughts: IV
mentions.text: Cartethyia had passed the hope to you, and you entrusted it to me.

mentions.title: The Nameless
mentions.text: Sometimes, when Cartethyia spoke to her, she had to pause for a long while before she could muster a reply. Cartethyia didn't think so, but the Nameless could no longer hold on.

mentions.title: Big Little Things
mentions.text: She whisked Rover and Cartethyia on a carefree whirlwind tour through Septimont.

mentions.title: Flames of Heart
mentions.text: In those three days of the story where Cartethyia didn't rescue me, I would always die on the first day, helplessly watching as my home slowly crumbled to dust.

mentions.title: Shadow of Glory
mentions.text: I don't know if this Cartethyia of yours is strong enough to take on Arsinosa. If she did, it would be the talk of Septimont.

mentions.title: Flames of Heart
mentions.text: Sadly, the playwright did eventually erase Lupa's existence. As for me, I descended into the submerged aqueducts where I found the Threnodian. It had inhabited Mya's remains and was hiding within an experimental unit.

sceneQuests: Where Stars Cascade Down · event story

voicelines.title: About Jinhsi
voicelines.text: Jinhsi is a bright and diligent soul. With time, she will undoubtedly blossom into a capable Magistrate. She has always been dedicated to her work, perhaps too much so. She simply needs some time to find balance and fully embrace who she truly is. I am entrusting her care to you, Rover.

voicelines.title: About Changli
voicelines.text: Over the years, my esteemed teacher Changli has taught me much… Yet her smiling eyes still hold mysteries that I cannot yet comprehend.

mentions.title: Changli's Trouble
mentions.text: Jinhsi's iced pastries and Sanhua's delicate snow birds always melt faster than I'd prefer in my hands...

mentions.title: About Sanhua
mentions.text: But both Jinhsi and I have always wished for her to take a well-deserved rest and let others help shoulder the burden.

mentions.title: Beneath the Whispers
mentions.text: It is said that Counselor Changli did not become a Counselor after the Sentinel chose the Jinzhou Magistrate, but she had long volunteered to come to Jinzhou, to teach the young Jinhsi, and to help her take over the power that was too heavy for a child. After the ceremony, Changli gave up power to Jinhsi and became her Counselor.

mentions.title: Master and Minister
mentions.text: Before becoming Jinhsi's tutor, Changli had only met her once when she was a young girl. As Jinhsi works tirelessly at City Hall, Changli remains by her side, answering questions and offering advice whenever needed.

mentions.title: Mianloong Chamber (Quest)
mentions.text: My teacher Changli told me it's up to both of us to solve the crisis at Mt. Firmament. As I know you have a special connection with our Sentinel, I need your support in this decision.

mentions.title: Truthseeker's Pass (Quest)
mentions.text: I... *cough*... but Changli, your...

voicelines.title: About Sanhua
voicelines.text: Sanhua is always composed and silent. As a bodyguard, she remains vigilant and alert at all times. But both Jinhsi and I have always wished for her to take a well-deserved rest and let others help shoulder the burden.

mentions.title: Changli's Trouble
mentions.text: Jinhsi's iced pastries and Sanhua's delicate snow birds always melt faster than I'd prefer in my hands...

mentions.title: Clashing Blades
mentions.text: Is Lady Changli leaving for the capital?

mentions.title: To Mt. Firmament
mentions.text: You're here because I invited you. Sanhua was instructed to disclose my whereabouts if you ever went to City Hall and asked about Jinhsi.

voicelines.title: About Jiyan
voicelines.text: Upon my initial arrival in Jinzhou, I was tasked with handling paperwork at the City Hall for a temporary period. Despite sifting through countless documents and files, never once did I come across any issues regarding our border defenses. During the time when Jinzhou was lacking a Magistrate, General Jiyan's unwavering efforts were essential in protecting the welfare of our people.

voicelines.title: About Jianxin
voicelines.text: Although we followed different sects of Taoist teachings, I found commonalities with her. Her pure and open mind is quite rare nowadays. I believe her perception of the world must be as clear as her eyes. I first met her at the tea house; back then, she seemed to have sensed something about my condition, and served me a bowl of Lotus Seed Soup. That was a delightful surprise.

voicelines.title: About Chixia
voicelines.text: Chixia is a vibrant girl, radiating warmth and enthusiasm like a shining flame. She graciously showed me around Jinzhou, introducing me to all the local gems and delectable delicacies. Ah, yes, now I remember... The Spicy Pulled Chicken may seem intimidating to many, but it's just the right amount of spice for me.

mentions.title: The Myth-Laden Savior
mentions.text: "...Steadfastly by the side of Sentinel Jué, in a bond of intimate camaraderie." From then on, everything unfolded precisely as Sentinel Jué predicted.

mentions.title: Truthseeker's Pass (Quest)
mentions.text: Rover, Jué, and Mt. Firmament... There must be some kind of crucial connection between the three. Rover has own reasons for being here.

mentions.title: Immortal Blaze
mentions.text: Yes. Information on the actual powers of Jué... This isn't the kind of information an ordinary explorer can obtain.

voicelines.title: About Namipon
voicelines.text: Born of love. Always kind and dependable... That's the Guardian of Honami City. Or at least, that's how it likes to introduce itself. Being around Namipon feels peaceful. Hard to explain. Sometimes it follows me, quietly. I won't notice until it brushes up against me, soft fur against my arm, asking if I want coffee. But there's something more beneath that face. Something vast. Maybe it's just... trying to return the love people once gave it.

mentions.title: Stagnant Dawn on Wastelands
mentions.text: But here's what we do know: After the Lament, Namipon gained a physical form and a will of its own. And as Honami's mascot, it knows the city like the back of its paw. The layout, the pathways. I believe that makes it a pretty reliable partner.

mentions.title: Flowing Starlight in the Iris
mentions.text: I just remembered... Namipon always said the cafe needed more life. Maybe now is the time to try?

mentions.title: The Wind Before the Storm
mentions.text: Last break, I made time to go back to Honami. Brought Namipon some Roya snacks. And Namipon said.. it really hopes you'll go back to visit.

mentions.title: When the Unknown Thrums
mentions.text: Namipon, Shorekeeper... thank you. For looking after me during this time.

mentions.title: Stranger Things in Honami/Story
mentions.text: It's too soon to jump to conclusions. But the Meishin Passageway she mentioned is highly suspect… Has anyone reported strange happenings there, Namipon?

mentions.title: Star Bouncing · event story
mentions.text: I just... started to talk like Namipon.

voicelines.title: About Buling
voicelines.text: She's a very fascinating Taoist. If I remember correctly, she's from Mengzhou, in Huanglong? She's always saying odd metaphors and local sayings, and showing off the rare antiques she carries around. Once even offered me a "Buy two, get 20% off" deal. Maybe... I'll take her up on it. Just to see.

mentions.title: Flowing Starlight in the Iris
mentions.text: You must be Buling?

mentions.title: Flowing Starlight in the Iris
mentions.text: Good to meet you, Chisa. And this floating one here... Hmm...

voicelines.title: About Shorekeeper
voicelines.text: Shorekeeper helped me a lot while I've been recovering at the Black Shores. It took me a while to settle in, but in time, I started to feel the kindness there. Shorekeeper once took me to the beach at the Haven of Sprouts to see the stars. They were infinite. And I found myself thinking... Sumika must've stood beneath that same sky many times, imagining the future she hoped to reach.

mentions.title: Flowing Starlight in the Iris
mentions.text: Chisa remained on the verge of Overclocking for a prolonged period within a distorted temporal flow. Her case required a full evaluation by the Tethys System.

mentions.title: When the Unknown Thrums
mentions.text: This? Chisa taught me how to make this beverage. I find it tastes better with more milk and sugar...

mentions.title: Flowing Starlight in the Iris
mentions.text: Yes. Shorekeeper personally oversaw all of the routine checkups during my recovery. She was very helpful.

mentions.title: When the Unknown Thrums
mentions.text: Namipon, Shorekeeper... thank you. For looking after me during this time.

quests.quest: Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song

voicelines.title: About Yangyang
voicelines.text: Yangyang's such a darling, even her words sound pretty! Sometimes I can't quite get what she says though. Whatcha call those again? Ah, poems, I think!

voicelines.title: About Chixia
voicelines.text: "When in trouble, ask Chixia, the Ally of Justice!" This statement, while playful, rings very true. With her surging passion, seasoned prowess, and abundant vigor, Chixia already meets every quality a hero should have, helping the people in need.

mentions.title: The Secret to Listening
mentions.text: That's why Chixia was shocked at Yangyang's ability to accurately hum a melody she had only heard. Soon enough, Chixia told everyone else about Yangyang's amazing talent, sparking playful requests for a song.

mentions.title: Utterance of Marvels: I
mentions.text: Also, we have Resonators who can detect the formation of Tacet Fields nearby, like what Yangyang just did. She can tell all kinds of information by reading the Streams in the wind—that's her Resonance Ability.

mentions.title: The Wind Before the Storm
mentions.text: Ain't the same. Anybody with eyes can tell ya, a smile ain't just a smile. There's the smile you put on 'cause you're s'posed to, and the smile that comes from the heart. So what's got my Yangyang smilin' like that, I wonder...

mentions.title: Echoing Marche
mentions.text: It's a no-go for me if you're leaving the city, my shift's coming up. Protect Rover well and shoot me a message if you need anything, alright Yangyang?

mentions.title: First Resonance
mentions.text: Aren't you forgetting something, Yangyang? Rover told us this morning that he/she has been offered a stay at the City Hall...

mentions.title: Grand Warstorm
mentions.text: Rover, Yangyang, I'll be keepin' the city safe as a Patroller. Do come back in one piece, okay?

voicelines.title: About Yinlin
voicelines.text: She was once the thunder that lit up my path ahead. I've always wanted to be like her, until I realized not everyone had that power. Now, I am happy with being a small flicker of flame, doing what I can to help people around me.

voicelines.title: About Chixia
voicelines.text: I guess you can say Chixia is a younger colleague of mine. She is a natural fit for the Patroller position. With time and experience, she will surely excel in her role.

voicelines.title: About Lingyang
voicelines.text: Sometimes they'd perform liondance between hero plays. That leading dancer, Lingyang, can put on quite a show for a small guy like him! The way he moves and swings around really makes for an awesome lion!

voicelines.title: About Chixia
voicelines.text: Chixia? Aha, you mean my top rival! I won't let her outshine me again... And why is that, you ask? Well, we're battling to see who can help more people!

quests.quest: Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song
Disappearance Case: The Visitor from Jinzhou

voicelines.title: About Rover
voicelines.text: You don't talk much, but you're so strong in battle. There's a good old Huanglong saying, "A cat that catches mice doesn't meow." Fits perfectly on you, doesn't it?

mentions.title: The Wind Before the Storm
mentions.text: There's Yangyang. She's kind, and very pleasant to be around. Chixia. Loyal, strong sense of justice. She goes by another name too.

mentions.title: Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song
mentions.text: Hello? What's up, Chixia?

mentions.title: The Chant of Unseen Ties
mentions.text: You can worry about that later, Chixia. Just focus on recovering for now.

mentions.title: Solitary Path
mentions.text: (I should use it to inform Chixia and the others of my situation, and my current coordinates.)

mentions.title: Disappearance Case: The Visitor from Jinzhou
mentions.text: I can confirm this lady isn't Chixia. Aside from the red hair, they have nothing in common.

mentions.title: Moonlit Reunion
mentions.text: (Wishes... and solutions...? Could this relate to what Chixia said about "someone" at Moontree Lodge making wishes come true? And Xiangli Yao... The name sounds familiar.)

bonds.label: Acquainted

voicelines.title: About Carlotta
voicelines.text: She's a discerning buyer and a skilled seller. Whether modern or vintage, Carlotta always appraises art with a fair and thoughtful eye. She taught me that the beauty of art transcends time, and that every artist will eventually find an audience that appreciates their vision.

mentions.title: For Herself, She Shall Sing
mentions.text: As the girl with antlers watches you and Carlotta emerge from the wind, something tells her she too might soon be swept into a story.

mentions.title: The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier
mentions.text: I was sent by Lady Carlotta to find you. As I passed that abandoned house, I suddenly felt this... well, you know, rush of inspiration that just can't be ignored! So, I stopped to compose a piece...

mentions.title: A Stranger in a Strange Land
mentions.text: Carlotta!

mentions.title: Your Summer Will Never Wither (Quest)
mentions.text: But this time, I have you and my friends with me... I can't let you all repeat my fate. If we step onto that stage tomorrow, the Order will not stand idly by. They might even come after you and Carlotta...

mentions.title: The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier
mentions.text: Hello, Rover. I received Ciaccona's memo.

mentions.title: Your Summer Will Never Wither (Quest)
mentions.text: When I was a child, whenever I passed by Ciaccona's house, I'd always hear music drifting from the courtyard. Lively, spirited and so full of emotion...

sceneQuests: A Stranger in a Strange Land

bonds.label: Acquainted

voicelines.title: About Phoebe
voicelines.text: There was a time when I thought about telling her the truths about the Order, but after seeing her devotion as she stood in front of the Sentinel's statue, praying for the people of Ragunna, I abandoned the idea. For an Acolyte as kind as she is, perhaps the truth may do more harm than good, just as it did to me.

sceneQuests: A Stranger in a Strange Land

bonds.label: Acquainted

voicelines.title: About Brant
voicelines.text: He's a captivating performer on stage. Sometimes I wonder about Brant's fate. Will he be written into the pages of history after countless adventures? Or will he spend his retirement years recounting his legendary tales on a ship somewhere, holding a bottle of Troupe Strength?

mentions.title: All Out! Towards the Peaks of Prestige (Quest)
mentions.text: Captain Brant of the Fool's Troupe? I doubt anyone could outdo his price. I hear the entire Troupe relies on his bounty to survive.

mentions.title: Your Summer Will Never Wither (Quest)
mentions.text: As you've already seen, I was also banished. You‘ve probably heard a lot about the Pilgrim's Sail from Brant.

sceneQuests: All Out! Towards the Peaks of Prestige (Quest)

bonds.label: Know of each other

voicelines.title: About Mortefi
voicelines.text: Mortefi may seem a bit intimidating, but he's actually quite nice. Once my blade got really worn out, and Mortefi repaired it for me. To repay his kindness, that week I wiped out several groups of bandits eyeing the Tacetite weapons he developed... He ended up having to repair it for me again.

sceneQuests: Depths of Illusive Realm · event story

voicelines.title: About Chixia
voicelines.text: You can never go wrong by taking lost children to Chixia. While some kids may find me scary, they would never be scared of her.

voicelines.title: About Yinlin
voicelines.text: The familiar sight of Yinlin's thunder always reassures me that the upcoming battle will be a breeze. Though, I must admit, it took me until at least our tenth collaboration to finally learn her name... Embarrassingly so.

voicelines.title: About Yangyang
voicelines.text: When I just met Yangyang, I had been curious how someone could always be such a sweetheart. Later, I finally learned how gentleness with boundary has a powerful strength of its own.

voicelines.title: About Danjin
voicelines.text: I met Danjin a few times on different occasions. I could tell how much she values justice. She is very clear about when to unsheath her blade, and for what she fights, despite being surprisingly young. Her actions reflect her belief in an ideal world—one that she is determined to create.

quests.quest: Faithful Heart Tested at Skyfall: Epilogue
Depths of Illusive Realm · event story

voicelines.title: About Rover
voicelines.text: You always act first in the face of injustice, despite having lost all memories... You must always have been a righteous person, right? I'd be very troubled if it turned out otherwise.

mentions.title: Faithful Heart Tested at Skyfall: Epilogue
mentions.text: A "Danjin Special" Loong Whiskers Crisp. Now that's a one-of-a-kind gift.

mentions.title: Faithful Heart Tested at Skyfall
mentions.text: But from what she just told me, it sounds like you're under supervision. Suyu, did Danjin do something to warrant this?

voicelines.title: About Sigrika
voicelines.text: I find myself wondering... how nice would it be if Sigrika were just an ordinary girl? Without all that weight on her shoulders. They say you eventually have to pay for being innocent, but what did the kind and pure ever do to deserve that? The world can be so cruel. It punishes the kindest people and calls it "growth." Like that makes any sense. But through it all, Siggy has never been afraid... She really is amazing.

voicelines.title: About Denia
voicelines.text: Nia always says, "If you can't finish it, just drop it. Toss away whatever's hard or sad. Running away makes everything so much easier." But whenever I'm up late studying, she's always right there beside me. Sometimes I think… maybe she's actually the one who least wants to run away. She never talks about herself, so I can't quite see what's going on in her heart. Still... I hope we can stay friends for a very, very long time.

mentions.title: A Bright Light
mentions.text: Denia first met Sigrika during a group assignment. "But why me, Sigrika?"

mentions.title: A Lie
mentions.text: Sigrika, chasing birds through a sunset field.

mentions.title: Beneath a Melting Night Sky
mentions.text: I used to tell myself that was karma. But what does an ending like that mean for Sigrika? For Nastasha? For someone like you, who always tries to save everyone?

mentions.title: Gold Suspended in Shadows
mentions.text: Made your decision? Well, no one's going to blame you. Not everyone's built like Sigrika.

mentions.title: Beneath a Melting Night Sky
mentions.text: Senior, do you remember Denia? You met her at the New Solar Celebration. She was the one who got us those tickets.

mentions.title: Gold Suspended in Shadows
mentions.text: Denia was supposed to hand them out, but she's taken a few days off. Odd that Nivora's on leave, too. I wonder if they planned it...

voicelines.title: About Hiyuki
voicelines.text: That miko from Ashinohara is so powerful. Like she's cheating, you know? Yeah, I'd heard the stories before. But facing that power myself was a whole different story. She wasn't exactly what I pictured, though. Beyond all that strength and the gentleness you can tell right from her face, there's something else, almost... clinging to her. Something that won't wash away. Loneliness... or maybe regret? If growing stronger really comes with a price, I wonder… what has she given up to get this power?

voicelines.title: About Denia
voicelines.text: I... believe I failed her, in a way. Had I been quicker to see through the Fractsidus's plot, she might not have suffered as she did. I borrowed your strength when I delivered that strike. Only then was I able to restore a whisper of her true self back to her. I pray it caused no lasting harm. I am told that she is recovering. If we meet again, I will offer my apologies in person.

mentions.title: Beneath a Melting Night Sky
mentions.text: It definitely would! Hiyuki is... well... kind of scary, isn't she? Always popping up out of nowhere with a blade...

mentions.title: Starlights from Yesterdays
mentions.text: If you wish, I can tell you about my history with the Fractsidus. But of course, Denia is the more pressing matter.

mentions.title: So as the Melting Snow Desires
mentions.text: Their plans for Denia and me may have failed, but it proves one thing. They have found a way to harness Threnodian power.

voicelines.title: About Phrolova
voicelines.text: She was one of the few Overseers in the Fractsidus who would talk to me. When I was floating in the Voidmatter pod, she'd even play the violin for me. I really enjoyed her music. It's just... I never figured out how someone who could make such beautiful melodies... would ever want to help a maniac like the Grand Architect.

voicelines.title: About Mornye
voicelines.text: Professor Mornye fits every idea I've ever had of a perfect teacher: She has a soft voice, a sweet heart, she knows her stuff inside and out, and her classes are seriously intense. And the best part? She never, ever calls on me to answer questions when I'm napping in her class! Although... it might also be that no one has ever dared to sleep in her class before.

voicelines.title: About Denia
voicelines.text: You'll see her at every public lecture, nodding along as if she understands every word. Until she inevitably dozes off, jolts awake after bumping her head on the seat, and then drifts off again... I only later discovered that students receive credit solely for attendance.

mentions.title: A Bright Light
mentions.text: At night, they gazed at the star charts, watching the dreams Professor Mornye painted across the sky.

mentions.title: Beneath a Melting Night Sky
mentions.text: It's alright, Siggy. I'm sure you've got something really important to do with Professor Mornye.

voicelines.title: About Aemeath
voicelines.text: She's the legendary Fleet Snowfluff, right? I totally recognized her back in Voidspace. The Academy's former beloved star—even the toughest professors still talk about her after all these years. Plus, she still holds the top score on every single machine at the Mind Dive Arcade! Honestly, if you want your classmates to trust you, all you have to do is try to act like her... Her charm is seriously next level. Speaking of which... you must be really proud of her, huh? Make sure you protect her well this time. Don't ever lose her again.

mentions.title: Thoughts: III
mentions.text: Cosmos said you smell full of stories, and Cloudly told me you've been to many, many places.

mentions.title: Thoughts: V
mentions.text: Mommy's not with me anymore, and they say Cosmos and Cloudy are just my imaginary friends…

mentions.title: Chat: I
mentions.text: Cosmos and Cloudy are presents from mommy.

mentions.title: Let's be Friends!
mentions.text: Apologies if Cosmos accidentally bumps into you, it just tends to get a little too... excited.

mentions.title: A Kid from the Theater
mentions.text: Encore can't quite remember how long Cosmos and Cloudy have been part of her life. As a child, Encore secretly favored the cute Cloudy, a detail she never shared with Cosmos.

mentions.title: A Heroine's Return
mentions.text: The first time Cosmos and Cloudy spoke to Encore was at her mother's funeral. Cosmos bluntly complained.

voicelines.title: About Verina
voicelines.text: Verina's flowers are grown with love! Nothing like the ones they sell in the New Federation! But some of them looked a bit wacky, like the one that gobbled down on Aalto's head and gave him a new haircut… Gotta ask her what it's called next time!

voicelines.title: About Encore
voicelines.text: Little Encore is full of intriguing ideas, and she always has a lot of curious questions to ask. Hmm... I've got to keep looking for all the answers she wants. Oh, you're wondering why I call her "little"? Hehe, we're just playing big sister and little baby.

mentions.title: Small Wooly, Big Adventures
mentions.text: Hi Verina, er, not exactly. we're here to ask you how we can make the Wreath of Hope.

mentions.title: Small Wooly, Big Adventures
mentions.text: That's quite the selection, Encore. What do they all represent?

voicelines.title: About Mortefi
voicelines.text: Friends in Jinzhou told me Mortefi makes lots of fun gadgets and gizmos! That's so cool! Hmm, should I ask him for a bouncy sheep next time…

voicelines.title: About Calcharo
voicelines.text: Psst. Wanna hear a secret? That strange big guy Aalto's been working with is actually... a doggy person! That's why he's a big doggy in Encore's stories!

voicelines.title: About Jiyan
voicelines.text: Grown-ups like him have to wear a long face all the time, you know. See? Being a grown-up is really tough!

voicelines.title: About Encore
voicelines.text: Are you referring to the little girl who is always seen by Aalto's side? I have met her once. She and Aalto complement each other perfectly, personality wise.

bonds.label: Acquainted

voicelines.title: About Chixia
voicelines.text: Miss Chixia is another one of Encore's besties! She can get a bit strict sometimes, but in a good way! You can call her when you're lost in town, she doesn't mind the extra work.

mentions.title: Rewinding Raindrops
mentions.text: Hello, little one. Is your name Encore? Do you know this person?

sceneQuests: Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song

bonds.label: Acquainted

voicelines.title: About Cartethyia
voicelines.text: It was through the Dark Tide's memory that I first learned of her. I never saw her as anyone's Resonator, and in return, she gave me a reply that was... wild, reckless, but resolute. A knight of justice shouldn't be sealed away in a tower. The nightmare Leviathan cast upon her lasted far too long… But now that Rinascita has emerged from the darkness, she too should be free to embrace her own dawn.

mentions.title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
mentions.text: Perhaps longer than we can imagine. Even your clash with Cartethyia may have been scripted. A setup to give Leviathan a shot at slipping the Sentinel.

mentions.title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
mentions.text: That power you used... Was it the Sentinel's power of separation? And that incredible little one... No wonder Cartethyia had the nerve to propose such a mad plan.

mentions.title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
mentions.text: This might be the first real conversation we've had since everything ended. Thank you very much, Galbrena.

sceneQuests: Where Stars Cascade Down · event story

voicelines.title: About Aalto
voicelines.text: The Black Shores' database needs constant updates, and I send captured Tacet Discord data back like clockwork. I don't visit the base much, so Aalto is the one who always helps handle my performance check-ins. Of course, he never signs off on anything that doesn't benefit him. That's why half the data I send ends up counted as his work.

voicelines.title: About Calcharo
voicelines.text: While hunting in the New Federation, we had our eyes on the same Tacet Discord. His goal was to eliminate it. Mine was to absorb it. There were some misunderstandings along the way, but overall, it was a smooth collaboration. He actually invited me to join his mercenary group. Pack hunting is indeed important to survival, but... I'm just used to working alone.

voicelines.title: About Lynae
voicelines.text: She is a bright spirit. I am aware of certain secrets she carries. In a sense, we are both bound by our pasts. But she has a future she is galloping toward, one filled with light and hope she wholly deserves. That said, I still believe she should refrain from using her Forte to slip into class when she is late.

voicelines.title: About Chisa
voicelines.text: Chisa is also from Ashinohara. I have made a point to avoid meeting her. After all, in our homeland, Mikos only appeared in the darkest of times. We were never omens of good fortune—perhaps a parallel can be drawn to those detective comics popular nowadays. Besides, it may be unsettling to see a name from history standing before you in the flesh. Also, please do not speak to her of what transpired in Ashinohara. That burden is not hers to bear.

voicelines.title: About Aemeath
voicelines.text: A resilient child. She surely endured unimaginable hardship to return here. When she vanished within the simulator cockpit, I was out on a field assignment. The investigation team later briefed me on her case. The detail that made me pause was her writing "saving the world" as her career aspiration... Hm, I find myself wondering... what in her upbringing instilled this level of conviction?

mentions.title: Starlights from Yesterdays
mentions.text: Rover, I've read the Spacetrek Collective's report on Aemeath.

voicelines.title: About Sigrika
voicelines.text: She bears an awful load for a child of her age. She seeks to shoulder the expectations placed upon a Solsworn far ahead her own time. I have noticed her watching the Shiratori I send forth. Perhaps I should fold one for her before I depart?

bonds.label: Acquainted

voicelines.title: About Lucilla
voicelines.text: Though Lucilla insists our partnership is only contractual, I am well aware that without her discreet arrangements, I would have no place in the Spacetrek Collective, much less have obtained that blade. She carries herself lightly, yet the weight on her shoulders is plain to see. She often visits me, half in jest, declaring that she intends to "call it quits"—it is her way of venting. Before returning to Ashinohara, I should at least see her through the troubles presently at hand.

voicelines.title: About Hiyuki
voicelines.text: You, me, and Hiyuki. If I may, I'd like to presume we're "cut from the same cloth." Each of us had our reasons for starting down the path we're on now. Difference is, I journey to stay, whereas you and Hiyuki...

mentions.title: Even Should the Path Have No End
mentions.text: "Lucilla." Lucilla casually pulled a bottle of fine liquor from beneath the desk, a specialty from Ashinohara.

mentions.title: Starlights from Yesterdays
mentions.text: This is Hiyuki, I told you about her before. The only reason we could set up the monitoring equipment so quickly is because she cleared the way for us.

mentions.title: The Flaming Red from Tomorrow
mentions.text: Her name is Hiyuki. She's been helping the Collective survey the active Voidmatter zone. Simply put, she's in charge of protecting researchers and students who aren't equipped for a fight.

mentions.title: Wishes in the Bell
mentions.text: Her name is Hiyuki. She's been helping the Collective survey the active Voidmatter zone. Simply put, she's in charge of protecting researchers and students who aren't equipped for a fight.

mentions.title: So as the Melting Snow Desires
mentions.text: Hiyuki will meet you there instead.}}

mentions.title: Platya's Gift
mentions.text: Hah... You two might actually get along. Which is saying something. Hiyuki doesn't exactly do small talk.

sceneQuests: So as the Melting Snow Desires

voicelines.title: About Suoming
voicelines.text: When I was wholly consumed by remolding the Civilization Capsule and building Xuanfang Hold, Mengzhou weathered its trials alone. It was Intendant Suoming who bore the weight of the region's affairs on my behalf. I know she clings to obsessions she has no intention of releasing, using them as fuel to walk through storm and calm alike... Every time I think of it, I am flooded with guilt. I long for the day she finds what she seeks—the peace that only home can bring. For that to happen, I must be the Sentinel she deserves.

voicelines.title: About Hsin the Moon Fox
voicelines.text: After our bitter victory over the Evil Miasma, I resented the Sentinel for failing to appear while the black rain fell upon Huating. But when I finally stood before It, seeing Mengzhou as it was and finding It gravely wounded yet still straining to hold the enemies at bay... How could I hold onto my hatred? In the end, I accepted the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs' mandate and dedicated everything I have to It and to Mengzhou.

voicelines.title: About Hsin
voicelines.text: If we speak of age, Hsin is actually a bit younger than me. Having assisted the Sentinel for so long, watching Her grow into who She is today naturally carries a certain fondness. Whether it was Her solitary effort to remold the Civilization Capsule in the past, or Her finally stepping into Her role as the Sentinel now... Hsin has never once let the Sentinel down.

mentions.title: Thoughts: I
mentions.text: For a century, the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs has spoken on behalf of Hsin the Moon Fox to every Magistrate.

mentions.title: Thoughts: III
mentions.text: At Sentinel Hsin's behest, I joined the Ministry to purge Balanophora's remnants, restore order, and find a path forward.

mentions.title: Suoming's Trouble
mentions.text: I cannot say if it's just my imagination, but ever since Sentinel Hsin returned, Mengzhou seems to have more sunny days.

mentions.title: Ideals
mentions.text: For now, Hsin and Mengzhou's future must come first.

mentions.title: Birthday Wishes
mentions.text: May all be well in Hsin's keeping, and may your journey ahead be safe.

mentions.title: Join Team: I
mentions.text: May all be well in Hsin's keeping.

voicelines.title: About Qingxiao
voicelines.text: The Xuan Paragon appears cold and distant, but she is softer than she lets on. If you need something from her, all it takes is a little persistence, and she will fold. "I will not go," she says of the Waking Moon Festival, yet she never misses a single one. I have always seen that she carried the answer within her heart. She simply needed someone to give her a gentle push. Seeing her finally lay that burden down... it brings me immense joy. Come to think of it, if we were to count by age, I might even call her "Sister Qingxiao"... Oh my, but she must never hear me say that. She would tell me to stop foxing around.

voicelines.title: About Hsin
voicelines.text: Hsin is one to follow Her whims, and carries a wealth of emotions unlike any other Sentinel of Huanglong. It was She who first invited me to hold the honorary title of Xuan Paragon in Xuanfang Hold. In those days, She would often come up the mountain, regaling me with anecdotes and trivia, and once She started, She could go on for hours. Only when I played the qin would She fall quiet. Sometimes, as She listened, a flicker of loneliness would cross Her face… She always believed She hid it well from me.

mentions.title: Disliked Food
mentions.text: Hsin learned of this one day and secretly added Chongzhou chili sauce to some pastries she had me try.

mentions.title: Song of the Heart Sword
mentions.text: At this point in time, I hadn't yet accepted Hsin's request to serve as the Xuan Paragon. The "Sword Transcendent" title only came from an embellished tale.

mentions.title: Simulacrum of the Heart
mentions.text: Hsin keeps no set path, so a flickering presence is nothing new... She vanishes for a time, then reappears as if nothing happened, chattering of trifles.

mentions.title: Song of the Heart Sword/Extra
mentions.text: My disciple, you accepted Hsin's power before, and your body still needs time to adapt to it. You have been running ragged across Xuanfang lately without a moment's rest.

mentions.title: Together, Into the Worldly Splendor
mentions.text: My disciple, you accepted Hsin's power before, and your body still needs time to adapt to it. You have been running ragged across Xuanfang lately without a moment's rest.

mentions.title: Song of the Heart Sword
mentions.text: Paragon Qingxiao, should disaster one day befall Xuanfang Hold, I hope you will raise your sword for its people.

voicelines.title: About Suisui
voicelines.text: Now there is a remarkably clever young woman. I have seen so many lose their way in the world of commerce, but she navigates it with purpose, her heart set on something larger than profit, pursuing it with the same innate force as the wind rising over water. She even dared to try and outmaneuver me, a Sentinel, heedless of the consequences! And yet, I knew at a glance—her wish is the same as mine. Besides, she has long since seen through me. So I let her be. And as it turns out... I chose well.

voicelines.title: About Hsin
voicelines.text: Unlike the other Sentinels of Huanglong, Hsin doesn't feel like a divinity looking down from on high. Somehow, I see a part of her that's unmistakably "human." Maybe it's because I know how much she loves this mortal world that I dared to stand before her.

mentions.title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
mentions.text: I'm sorry, Rover, for keeping this from you. My deal with Hsin was meant to stay between us. Until I stood before Her, I wasn't sure if revealing the truth would help or just make things worse.

voicelines.title: About Xuanqing
voicelines.text: Though I never truly met her, she remains vividly undimmed, unfaded, as real as breath and bone within the Moon Fox's memories. I sometimes wonder, had she never existed, would the Sentinel have ever thought to create me? Emotion... is the hardest thing to put into words.

mentions.title: Moonlike Heart, Mortal Longing
mentions.text: But a newborn consciousness can't handle too much feeling all at once. She needed time to learn. "Joy," "sorrow," "anger," "fear"... She sealed these emotions away, and as "Hsin" lived among mortals, She gradually received them.

mentions.title: Moonlike Heart, Mortal Longing
mentions.text: Resonator of Sentinel Hsin the Moon Fox... Xuanqing.

voicelines.title: About "Jué"
voicelines.text: Jué... It is the youngest of all the Huanglong Sentinels, and yet no one is more rigid in following the ordained path. Perhaps it is because of Its Temporal Mandate that It values the weight of each "choice" so dearly. When It came to consult with the Moon Fox on the raising of a city, It had exhausted every ounce of Its computational power in seeking a future for the people... Had I not acted in the Fortress and Gorges War, its fires would have reached the very heart of the Jinmen Pass. Jué had cultivated the seeds of Jinzhou with such care, I could not bear to watch them wither. And now, Jinzhou flourishes with lanterns and laughter, year after year. Jué's gambit... was not made in vain.

voicelines.title: About Lupa
voicelines.text: Anyone who's seen her matches probably feels the urge to challenge her as well, wouldn't you agree? Her passion for competition is really something... Pure, simple, and completely genuine. For her, victory and glory are just icing on the cake compared to the joy of the fight. She's not afraid to lose, but her passion always drives her to give her all and never back down, no matter the odds.

voicelines.title: About Iuno
voicelines.text: I rarely visit the Temple to pray for revelations, so I can't say I know the Priestesses well. But I do like Iuno. Many of the nobles can't stand her unconventional ways, but I find her boldness entertaining. Don't you?

voicelines.title: About Iuno
voicelines.text: A spirited, nimble girl... That's my impression of her. Once, I saw her sprint along the narrow bricks at the top of the high wall and leap onto a statue like a cat. No clue who was chasing her, but I cheered loudly along with everyone else at the foot of the wall!

mentions.title: Shadow of Glory
mentions.text: The Priestess of Septimont has the authority to make final judgments. Iuno, in particular, is one of Ephor Augusta's staunchest allies.

voicelines.title: About Avidius
voicelines.text: He roared at fate with everything he had. Sure, that roar was swiftly reduced to whimpers, then silence, but we all heard it. It left its mark... I think he's more like the Hero of Heroes when he stops worrying about what that even means or what others expect from him.

mentions.title: By Sun's Burning Hand
mentions.text: Though... Avidius makes me rather uncomfortable. It's got nothing to do with his stance, it's... more of a hunch. Something about him feels... unnatural.

mentions.title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
mentions.text: I see, Ragunna too... And Avidius... He never bent the knee, never played by the rules. Why is it that fate always strikes hardest at those who dare to defy it?

voicelines.title: About Carlotta
voicelines.text: She and her family always manage to bring something fresh to Septimont and Ragunna, even to themselves. And before you know it, those little novelties spark whole new trend.... Me? Yep, I usually end up buying whatever it is. It's just hard to resist. She always gets what I like. Those Montellis, cunning as ever!

voicelines.title: About Chixia
voicelines.text: Chixia always invites me to spar. She's really good with her guns, and I've learned so much from those fights. I admire her dedication and genuineness. It's great to have made a friend while honing my fighting skills.

voicelines.title: About Yuanwu
voicelines.text: Occasionally I'd leave my sect to go on what we call self-cultivating trips. During one of those trips, I visited Mr. Yuanwu's boxing gym and challenged him to fight, and I won. I told Master Shiling about it when I returned, and it turns out Mr. Yuanwu's ancestors used to practice martial arts at our sect. According to the rules, I guess I should call him my "martial senior". I heard that Mr. Yuanwu went through a lot when he was younger, but it seems he doesn't want me to talk too much about it, so let's just drop it there.

voicelines.title: About Jianxin
voicelines.text: I am more than happy to get an outstanding training partner like Jianxin by merely offering her a simple meal... Of course, I'm always pleased to spend time with her over a meal, whether she's here to train with me or not.

voicelines.title: About Suisui
voicelines.text: The famous Madam Chongming Pruner... efficient, sharp-minded, and knows her way around all sorts. The Zhaoming Commerce Guild keeps growing with her at the helm. Rare goods from cities in and even outside of Huanglong keep flowing through her hands. Hm, color me impressed—I've seen my fare share of relics and curios. But if she's got the touch to gather all these lost treasures and put them back on the market... hah, that takes real skill.

voicelines.title: About Jingran
voicelines.text: The Cat of the Nether Lamp… the rumors make him sound like a ghost story. A figure in black, drifting through shadows with a Nether Lamp and the chill of the netherworld clinging to him. I've only met him a few times. Despite his youth, his eyes have the look of someone who has weathered storms that would break lesser men. He is utterly uninhibited, and it makes me curious: is there anything in this world that could actually hold him back?

voicelines.title: About Qingxiao
voicelines.text: There's an old story. A girl went looking for a Transcendent in the mountains, panicked when she ran into Tacet Discords, and fell off a cliff. At the last second, she was saved by a flying sword. That girl? That was my Shifu's old lady. I heard that story a thousand times as a kid. Honestly? Never believed a word of it. Until I saw someone flying across the sky on a blade... There aren't any divinities in Xuanfang, but there is the Xuan Paragon.

voicelines.title: About Jingran
voicelines.text: Years ago, his master crossed paths with me and casually asked for a divination before venturing into a Mirage Realm. I know only a little of the art, but I obliged regardless... It was an ill omen. Yet he simply grinned and went on. Later, this young man took up his master's mantle, the smile on his face even more defiant. Even if the road ahead is treacherous and life is fleeting, to live unburdened and unbound... I suppose that, too, is a life well lived.

mentions.title: Song of the Heart Sword
mentions.text: Rover, Paragon Qingxiao...

mentions.title: Song of the Heart Sword
mentions.text: The wound was fatal. It must have been the strike Jingran landed earlier.

voicelines.title: About Sanhua
voicelines.text: Amidst my busy days, meals can easily slip my mind. Before I knew it, it would be well past the time for another meal. But like a blessing, Sanhua would always appear with a plate of delicious Loong Buns, filled with exactly what I was craving. I am in awe… How does she know every time?

voicelines.title: About Jinhsi
voicelines.text: Lately, my lady prefers to wake up earlier, so I've been waking her up on time every day… Huh? She sometimes prefer to stay in bed a bit longer?! Is that what she told you? What else did she say? Please, do tell me in detail.

mentions.title: Thoughts: I
mentions.text: Other than my lady Jinhsi, you are the only person who looks so clear and true.

mentions.title: Sanhua's Hobby
mentions.text: Occasionally I would recite it for my lady Jinhsi, but she always started to grow sleepy after a while...

mentions.title: Self-Introduction
mentions.text: I am Sanhua, the bodyguard of Magistrate Jinhsi.

mentions.title: The Magistrate's Bodyguard
mentions.text: Sanhua is always seen standing silently behind Jinhsi, maintaining an adequate distance. Although the majority of voices opposing Jinhsi have already subsided, there are still a handful of individuals who would attempt to challenge her authority.

mentions.title: Lingering Coldness
mentions.text: So when she was jostled awake from another nightmare and noticed the presence of light, she immediately realized that it must be Jinhsi still working on her documents. Jinhsi pondered for a moment, then offered a mischievous smile, "If you want to help, just stay and chat with me for a while.

mentions.title: Thawing Frost
mentions.text: Jinhsi has shown Sanhua the power of rebirth in destruction. Jinhsi...

voicelines.title: About Taoqi
voicelines.text: Taoqi is able to breeze through mountains of workload with ease, despite her frequent yawns. Her efficiency is truly remarkable.

voicelines.title: About Jinhsi
voicelines.text: People think Lady Jinhsi is too young to lead, but I don't see the problem. Her young age may be seen as a disadvantage, but it's also her greatest strength. As we work on moving Jinzhou forward, she will go further and accomplish more than any of us can imagine.

mentions.title: Her Wish-granting Magic
mentions.text: "Dear Magistrate, I'm worried about Tacet Discords infiltrating our city."—Taoqi, director of the Defense Division, was then tasked with fortifying the city defense walls.

mentions.title: About Sanhua
mentions.text: Where on earth did Lady Jinhsi find herself such an incredible bodyguard?

mentions.title: Grand Warstorm
mentions.text: Well done, Director Taoqi.

mentions.title: The One that Impresses
mentions.text: Rover, do you know the whereabouts of Sanhua, Ms. Taoqi, and General Jiyan?

bonds.label: Acquainted

voicelines.title: About Jiyan
voicelines.text: "Qingloong rise, monsters gone"... Every child in Jinzhou knows this nursery rhyme by heart. My faith rests with Jiyan, for with his protection the Tacet Discords will never breach our borders.

voicelines.title: About Jinhsi
voicelines.text: The "battle" Magistrate Jinhsi has been taking on may prove more complicated than our situation in the borderlands: stipulating rules, overseeing trade, ensuring the well-being of the people, and managing the city's functioning all demand her coordination and judgement. Every time I return to Jinzhou, I can feel the city's vibrancy and enthusiasm, all thanks to her meticulous governance.

mentions.title: Clashing Blades
mentions.text: I suppose so. General Jiyan is currently battling another TD Outbreak in the Norfall Barrens, which will also serve as our frontline against the Threnodian.

mentions.title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
mentions.text: Then it is settled. I will speak with General Jiyan and arrange for your temporary transfer to the Xuanfang Ministry of War.

mentions.title: The One that Impresses
mentions.text: Rover, do you know the whereabouts of Sanhua, Ms. Taoqi, and General Jiyan?

sceneQuests: Where Stars Cascade Down · event story

voicelines.title: About Rover
voicelines.text: I can feel it in my heart that we both have something we'll fiercely defend, a cause worth fighting for... And we won't back down, no matter what it takes.

mentions.title: Her Long-awaited Guest
mentions.text: It brings me great joy to see you, Rover."

mentions.title: The Wind Before the Storm
mentions.text: (Yangyang hasn't written back yet. Yangyang, Chixia, Baizhi... and even Jinhsi. I wonder how everyone's doing?)

mentions.title: Rewinding Raindrops
mentions.text: Jiyan the General, Jinhsi the Magistrate, and Jué, Jinzhou's Sentinel... Is there any kind of connection between them?

mentions.title: Dreamweaver's Ascent
mentions.text: Jinhsi said she'll go search for the Sentinel and update me on its whereabouts.

mentions.title: Road of Pilgrimage
mentions.text: Jinhsi, so far, everything we know about the Sentinel is still just speculation.

mentions.title: The Commander of Time
mentions.text: ...If I open it, Jinhsi is bound to face you in the ultimate battle.

voicelines.title: About Mortefi
voicelines.text: Others often perceive Mortefi as arrogant and unapproachable, but, in fact, he is not that hard to talk to. Remember to be direct with him, as trying to be overly polite and subtle may only lead to misunderstandings.

voicelines.title: About Jiyan
voicelines.text: It was Jiyan who rescued me from the wilderness and referred me to the Academy, and I've been thankful for that... I have solved a lot of problems for him in return, of course. For example, all the Midnight Rangers currently use a one-piece medical kit of my design.

mentions.title: Grand Warstorm
mentions.text: Greetings, General Jiyan, Rover.

mentions.title: Riverside Games (Quest)
mentions.text: The lack of perceivable warning signs typically suggests unknown risks. Jiyan, Rover, stay safe.

mentions.title: Pastures like old times
mentions.text: By the way, the Riverside Games people were looking for you, Jiyan. Probably wanted to discuss holding the event again at a later date.

mentions.title: Grand Warstorm
mentions.text: Mortefi, it's time!

mentions.title: Pastures like old times
mentions.text: I trust you as always, Mortefi. But this sample... It means a lot to me.

mentions.title: Replica of Past Days
mentions.text: According to Mortefi's speculation, this Sonoro Sphere was resonating with the Riverside Games' frequencies, and it led to the abnormal fluctuations we detected earlier.

voicelines.title: About Taoqi
voicelines.text: Taoqi... Though our views on loose management don't always align, I am able to focus on the front lines without any worries, thanks to her effective leadership in maintaining Jinzhou's fortifications.

voicelines.title: About Jiyan
voicelines.text: General Jiyan's schedule is always so impossibly tight... He seems to keep finding more issues to take care of, like a devoted parent who never allows himself any rest. Maybe it's his doctor instincts, always putting others first. I really hope he can take some time off for his own well-being.

mentions.title: Grand Warstorm
mentions.text: I've informed General Jiyan that you're heading to his place. He will be meeting up with you soon.

mentions.title: Grand Warstorm
mentions.text: Madam Magistrate and Taoqi have informed me of your willingness to assist us. Thank you for lending u a hand.

voicelines.title: About Yangyang
voicelines.text: She can perceive minute changes in the surroundings from the Streams, but there is a limit to the amount of information a single person can take in. Excessive use of this ability might add to her burden, and I hope she won't strain herself.

voicelines.title: About Jiyan
voicelines.text: On the dangerous frontiers where we suffered immense losses, it was General Jiyan who stepped up to protect everyone, making all the tough decisions to ensure our safety. As the backbone of the Midnight Rangers, he has led us to countless victories as our Qingloong. The weight on his shoulders is beyond our imagination.

mentions.title: Echoing Marche
mentions.text: An imposing warrior wielding the power of a Qingloong... The Qingloong is the Midnight Rangers' emblem. It's also the symbol of General Jiyan, the leader of all Midnight Rangers.

mentions.title: Grand Warstorm
mentions.text: The Tacet Field Director Taoqi mentioned should be right up ahead. We must pass through it to reach our base and find General Jiyan.

mentions.title: A New Companion
mentions.text: General Jiyan and Rover later told me it was this little thing coming out of Rover's body. It was blocking, or even "consuming" the overflow of Threnodian power.

mentions.title: Grand Warstorm
mentions.text: And I'll join Rover, Yangyang, and Jianxin to create an opening for our main forces to take down the Threnodian.

voicelines.title: About Baizhi
voicelines.text: Many stumble through life directionless, without ever finding a purpose. Baizhi is among the rare few who have found their calling, and she is willing to give up anything for the truth she pursues.

voicelines.title: About Chixia
voicelines.text: That energetic and passionate Patroller? Yes, I have heard of her. She has been devoting her time to protecting the dreams of children in Jinzhou.

mentions.title: First Resonance
mentions.text: There's been TD outbreaks every year, but we can always trust General Jiyan, Madam Magistrate, and our Sentinel to have our backs! We're not ones to mess with!

mentions.title: Grand Warstorm
mentions.text: It's a pre-recorded broadcast message. Our Magistrate saw this coming, and she had General Jiyan devise an emergency plan a long time ago.

mentions.title: Rewinding Raindrops
mentions.text: Connection? ...No idea, but I did hear General Jiyan used to be a military doctor...

mentions.title: A New Companion
mentions.text: Well, both General Jiyan and Baizhi have confirmed it. No way they're lying.

voicelines.title: About Jiyan
voicelines.text: In Jinzhou, the liondance tradition started as a way to celebrate victories in battle. And nowadays, we always perform before our soldiers go into battle—it's like a good luck charm and morale booster. Our Liondance Troupe has been traveling between military camps in various regions to deliver performances. I'll never forget my first time leading a pre-battle show. I was nervous and messed up here and there, but General Jiyan didn't get mad at me. He actually encouraged me a lot. He isn't as strict as he seems in public, is he? No wonder the soldiers admire him so much... He's really a strong and kind person.

voicelines.title: About Jianxin
voicelines.text: Liondance is a fusion of martial arts and dance. It originated from traditional boxing and martial arts in Huanglong, emphasizing swift footwork and powerful postures. Miss Jianxin practices Fengyiquan, a contrasting style to liondance, but just as impressive. I once saw her effortlessly take down seven men with a single punch! The Fengyiquan truly lives up to its reputation: conquering the unyielding with the yielding.

voicelines.title: About Taoqi
voicelines.text: The Qixing Drum's sound echoes far and wide, and people say it scares evil spirits and beasts away. I never thought anyone could sleep through that loud banging, but then I met this pink-haired lady called Taoqi... Turns out she's the Chief Officer of border defense at the Ministry of Development. With all the defenses in Jinzhou, I'd be tired too... Maybe she is just too exhausted from work? I hope she can catch some good rest.

voicelines.title: About Yuanwu
voicelines.text: Uncle Yuanwu keeps lots of street cats at his boxing gym. I often bring them fish I've caught as thank-yous for, let's say, helping me practice. I wonder if those cats are picking up on his moves? Maybe I can draw some inspiration from that. By the way, Uncle Yuanwu's dried fish is super delicious!

voicelines.title: About Lingyang
voicelines.text: Lingyang often visits my gym to play with Mimi just outside the front doors, always carrying a couple of fresh tetras as treats. I guess it might be his thank-you to Mimi for all the agility training they had done together. He sure is a thoughtful young man.

voicelines.title: About Mortefi
voicelines.text: Don't let Mr. Mortefi's permanent 'Do-Not-Disturb' face fool you, he's actually a big kid at heart. He's the genius behind all those fun toys for Jinzhou's children, and he even created some sick merch for our Liondance Troupe! So when you need his help, don't hesitate to tell him—just do it politely and he'll surely lend you a hand!

voicelines.title: About Yangyang
voicelines.text: I love Yangyang's singing! I've been trying to convince her to sing at our theater, but she keeps turning me down.... Says she's embarrassed to sing in front of a crowd. I don't get it! It's just like liondancing—once you take that first step, the rest falls into place!

voicelines.title: About Baizhi
voicelines.text: The Remnant Creature that hangs around Baizhi... It's called You'tan, right? I once thought it was my kind. Aw. I wish it really was…

bonds.label: Acquainted

voicelines.title: About Aemeath
voicelines.text: Behind that lovely smile is pure steel. I feel inspired just hearing her voice—Heh, see? You're a better teacher than I am!

mentions.title: The Star That Voyages Far
mentions.text: You didn't mention it to Mornye, but I suspect... your possession of it traces back to Aemeath, doesn't it?

mentions.title: The Flaming Red from Tomorrow
mentions.text: This means we may actually have a chance in bringing back Aemeath—which is why Hiyuki took a risk, and used her familiar to probe deeper into the Voidmatter zone.

mentions.title: Wishes in the Bell
mentions.text: This means we may actually have a chance in bringing back Aemeath—which is why Hiyuki took a risk, and used her familiar to probe deeper into the Voidmatter zone.

mentions.title: All That Sunlight Touches
mentions.text: Ah. So this is about "Aemeath." was so tight-lipped with me about what happened in the frostlands, yet spoke to you.

sceneQuests: So as the Melting Snow Desires

voicelines.title: About Luuk Herssen
voicelines.text: He's got just a few too many mysteries for a doctor... But as a colleague, his skills speak for themselves. And that's what I trust.

voicelines.title: About Lucilla
voicelines.text: The President of the Academy and a... savvy adult. Lucilla knows what she wants, and what others want from her. Unlike those pedantic academics, she understands when to put her foot down and when to give ground for the sake of Startorch. She's like the undercurrents flowing beneath the Academy's ice cap—calm, quiet, and always keeping things afloat.

mentions.title: All That Sunlight Touches
mentions.text: You were a Synchronist in the Academy once before. I'll speak with Lucilla about getting you piloting access.

mentions.title: Starlights from Yesterdays
mentions.text: My conversation with Lucilla went well. She's on your side. Your showing during the Dark Side incident also helped speed up the Academy's internal review.

mentions.title: The Star That Voyages Far
mentions.text: All good on your end, golden ? Lucilla mentioned the Exostrider in the frostlands just moved. Please tell me that was you?

mentions.title: Ode to the Second Sunrise
mentions.text: (Chuckles) You can relax. Professor Lucilla has already given you the clear. You're not a suspect.

mentions.title: The Wind Before the Storm
mentions.text: Haha. Well, that depends on whether the Academy is willing to let me go. Somehow I doubt President Lucilla would say yes. She's already filled our schedules.

mentions.title: The Heartbeat of Life
mentions.text: Let me guess, did Lucilla ask you to handle the cleanup? Or were you given some kind of unavoidable assignment?

voicelines.title: About Sigrika
voicelines.text: She's just the cutest, isn't she? Pure, honest, trying so hard to carry the weight of the world on those tiny shoulders. Breaks my heart. But given my position, even a gentle pat on the cheek would likely only make her more anxious.

voicelines.title: About Lucilla
voicelines.text: President Lucilla's classes are so much fun. When she taught the history of Royan clothing, she even turned it into an impromptu styling workshop! But getting into her classes is almost impossible. Every time the course listings go up, I have to glue myself to the screen and click as fast as I can, or they'll be gone in seconds! And on the professor review forum, her page is just full of students complaining, "How can someone who teaches everything have classes that fill up in seconds?!"

mentions.title: Gold Suspended in Shadows
mentions.text: Precisely. It told Sigrika she would always return. To make that happen, it will have to issue a new riddle.

mentions.title: Rabbit Reflected in Shades
mentions.text: I have a general picture now. At the end of the Celebration, you and Sigrika entered the Dark Side to solve the final riddle, and encountered another "Sigrika."

mentions.title: Starlights from Yesterdays
mentions.text: Ah. That's what's on your mind. Well, I have an update. Remember Sigrika's friend? The… somewhat lackadaisical one?

mentions.title: The Flaming Red from Tomorrow
mentions.text: Huh? No reaction at all? That's odd. When Sigrika and the others ate theirs, they…

mentions.title: Gold Suspended in Shadows
mentions.text: Professor Lucilla said that no matter what happens, she believes I can face it. I'm not alone in this. With you, with her, with Dr. Luuk… none of us will let the Dark Side ruin the Academy.

mentions.title: The Wind Before the Storm
mentions.text: You'll get your chance! Besides, I heard President Lucilla say she wants to invite you back as a teaching assistant.

voicelines.title: About Denia
voicelines.text: She's kept it hidden so well, for so long. That just makes me blame myself and my heart ache for her more.

mentions.title: Starlights from Yesterdays
mentions.text: She also asked me to tell you that she's run into the Fractsidus there, including the missing girl, Denia.

mentions.title: Wishes in the Bell
mentions.text: So it's about Denia... I see. Let's discuss it in person.

voicelines.title: About Rebecca
voicelines.text: She always saw me as a choom, as part of the crew. But in all our time together, I never once opened up to her. It wasn't until she was gone that I realized... just how much I left unsaid.

voicelines.title: About Lucy
voicelines.text: Lucy... Dunno where to even start. Known her a while now, but can't say I really get her, y'know? Far as her netrunnin' skills go, she's a freakin' code wizard, can't deny that. I guess... no matter what, Lucy's crew. That answer your question?

mentions.title: Birthday Wishes
mentions.text: Rebecca's been on my case for weeks 'bout a party.

mentions.title: When the Sandevistan Hits
mentions.text: Hot-headed members like Rebecca threw themselves at the killer, while Lucy took cover to strike with caution.

mentions.title: My Moon My Man
mentions.text: Rebecca switched to stronger cyber-arms and swore she'd never lose anyone else. Rebecca and Falco—the remains of a loyal crew—threw themselves into the line of fire just to keep him moving.

mentions.title: So, Get Away
mentions.text: Rebecca and David were gone.

mentions.title: Rebecca's Hobby
mentions.text: Even Lucy the loner would stick around...

mentions.title: Self-Introduction
mentions.text: Edgerunner from Night City, just like Lucy.

voicelines.title: About Mornye
voicelines.text: "Tragedy did not extinguish her ideals. She works tirelessly to reach the stars with her own two hands." I mean, sh*t, you can feel the weight of these records just by reading them. If I hadn't met 'er myself, I'd call it a fairy tale. No one holds onto hope that tight... I respect her for it.

mentions.title: At Dream's Edge
mentions.text: ...But I can't crack the encryption solo. I'll wait to see if your Professor Mornye has any leads.

mentions.title: At Dream's Edge
mentions.text: While we can't fully decode your power, we can study and replicate the frequency signatures of Lucy and Rebecca's weapons, applying it to our own armaments.

voicelines.title: About Lynae
voicelines.text: When my Resonance Ability awakened, I hacked Lynae. Not on purpose, but I did see the memories she'd locked away. Hard to reconcile the weight of her past with that big, bright smile. Can't say we're all that different, her and I. I'm just glad she's finally free.

mentions.title: At Dream's Edge
mentions.text: Lynae... right? She's an interesting variable.

voicelines.title: About Lucilla
voicelines.text: We've never crossed paths, but her rep's solid. Hear she did a lot of heavy lifting with the Somnoire situation. The approachable Madam President, former editor for the Pioneer Association... Official file reads like a press release though. Bet the real story's a helluva lot more interesting. Wouldn't mind a face-to-face, see the woman behind the curtain.

mentions.title: At Dream's Edge
mentions.text: ...A parting gift from Lucilla. I can't take it with me. It's yours now.

voicelines.title: About Sigrika
voicelines.text: Sigrika is an interesting girl. Has a way of puttin' people at ease. But what gets me are the runes she uses. What are they? They seem to follow a unique operational logic... some kind of unparsed assembly language? What's the transmission method...?

mentions.title: So, Get Away
mentions.text: On the day she left the Somnoire, Lucy stopped at the threshold of the gateway and turned to Rover.

mentions.title: At Dream's Edge
mentions.text: Lucy is linked to that Nightmare Tacet Discord somehow. Figuring it out might be our ticket to stopping the spread.

voicelines.title: About Jianxin
voicelines.text: When I am out delivering packages, I can't always find a place to stay, so sometimes I rest outdoors. Once, I woke up to see Miss Jianxin napping on a boulder on the cliff edge! She seemed... so light, like a feather...

voicelines.title: About Chixia
voicelines.text: Ma Xiao...oops, I mean Chixia, hehe! Ahem, Patroller Chixia's packages are mostly snacks and hero play merchs. She was so stoked last time she got one, she practically bounced out of the room!

voicelines.title: About Youhu
voicelines.text: Youhu's packages always come with insurance, full of pricey antiques. I don't know much about these stuff, but the way she handles them, you can tell they're her treasures.

voicelines.title: About Baizhi
voicelines.text: Researcher Baizhi's packages weigh a ton! Mostly stacks of books, thick ones, and a bunch of other weird stuff. Said those are for research purposes...

voicelines.title: About Zhezhi
voicelines.text: Actually, I rarely get to meet Miss Zhezhi in person… She's a night owl, barely out during the day. So I've been dropping her paints and paper at her door.

bonds.label: Know of each other

voicelines.title: About Brant
voicelines.text: Many Gladiators of the Blue Furies come from the Troupe of Fools. I remember once, at Cliffside Harbor, I saw their captain leap off the deck just to hug his crew. They chattered on for a while, and then suddenly broke into song...!

mentions.text: She whisked Rover and Cartethyia on a carefree whirlwind tour through Septimont. But as everything was settled and the tension finally eased, a faint, nagging worry began to stir again in Lupa's heart, a worry for Rover, her best teammate ever.

mentions.title: Shadow of Glory
mentions.text: (That fleeting frequency... It was similar to the Threnodian's. Could it really be linked to the Dark Tide Lupa will bring forth in Septimont, as Phrolova said?)

mentions.title: Flames of Heart
mentions.text: (In this Great Agon, Lupa is the protagonist. Years ago, it was Mya. Now, I'm seeing Mya's image flicker in and out throughout this journey.)

voicelines.title: About Aemeath
voicelines.text: That child who means so much to you... I do see you in her. So bullheaded up against fate itself. So decisive and brave it leaves one speechless. At moments when that upbeatness flickers, I can tell that bright smile is just a mask she puts on, but if that's what she wants others to see, I'll respect it.

mentions.title: All That Sunlight Touches
mentions.text: With the Reactor Core returned, all you need now is a little patience. Wait for the Exostrider to awaken. Then we can focus on how to use it to find Aemeath.

mentions.title: The Star That Voyages Far
mentions.text: This "Aemeath" isn't exactly human, nor is she a Reverberation. She's closer to an Exoswarm, with only a trace of her original frequency remaining.

mentions.title: Starlights from Yesterdays
mentions.text: Based on your intel, the Reactor Core has been returned. Ideally, we'd wait for the Exostrider to awaken before trying to help Aemeath or confront the Threnodian.

voicelines.title: About Sigrika
voicelines.text: Sigrika... She shoulders a weight far too heavy for someone her age. Thankfully, there's candy to sweeten the gloom. She never hesitates to sample my newest candies. Her fearlessness has me impressed. Perhaps that curiosity of hers... is what finally lets her act her age.

voicelines.title: About Luuk Herssen
voicelines.text: After the New Solar Celebration incident, some students said we should make a banner for Dr. Luuk. It seems that whenever someone's feeling down, he's always there, checking on them, talking with them for as long as they need. They suggested things like "Startorch's Best Counselor" or "Best Doctor and Best Advisor." But if you ask me… I think I'd just write, "The One Who Always Has Candy."

mentions.title: All That Sunlight Touches
mentions.text: How to put this... I think you can have more faith in yourself, Sigrika.

mentions.title: Gold Suspended in Shadows
mentions.text: Do you still remember what I told you last time, Sigrika?

mentions.title: Starlights from Yesterdays
mentions.text: Candy? It's a new flavor. Sigrika and Lynae suggested it. Great for lifting spirits.

voicelines.title: About Sigrika
voicelines.text: When I first got here, Sigrika helped me get a handle on student life... She's super serious, the kind who never lets up on herself, you know? She never complains though, just bottles it all up inside. She's gonna hit a wall one day if she keeps that up... So, how about you and I... pull a little "intervention"? You know, take her out to have some real fun.

voicelines.title: About Lynae
voicelines.text: Lynae always comes and goes like the wind. Wherever she passes, she leaves behind these dazzling colors. Those colors are her riddles, and the smile on her face? That's always the answer.

mentions.title: Thoughts: II
mentions.text: New spray cans, odd parts for my seniors, candy from Sigrika...

mentions.title: Gold Suspended in Shadows
mentions.text: Sigrika? Sure, I know her. We were in the same year. She saved my butt in Royan Cultural History. I never would've passed that exam without her.

mentions.title: At Dream's Edge
mentions.text: ...Yeah. Oh, Rover, just between us. On the corner of the tag, Sigrika totally...

mentions.title: Gold Suspended in Shadows
mentions.text: It's so great to finally meet you! I'm Sigrika. Lynae's told me all about you. I can't believe you're the one who took down the Voidworm!

mentions.title: At Dream's Edge
mentions.text: Hey! We swore we'd keep that a secret, Lynae!

voicelines.title: About Mornye
voicelines.text: What do Professor Mornye and I have in common? Easy. We both hate sitting through class! So I took her for a drive one time. Total stone face the whole time, but I could tell she was loving it. The best part was the welcome committee when we got back. A whole pack of her researchers, swarming the gates like I'd just pulled a full-blown professor-napping. I mean, hello?! I kinda like my life here. And let's be real... if I were actually trying to sneak her out, nobody would've had a clue.

voicelines.title: About Lynae
voicelines.text: I wish to be like her, having the freedom to do what she wants. To act without constraint. Especially the constraint of a class schedule. It's a pity that professors are forbidden to skip their own lectures…

mentions.title: Ode to the Second Sunrise
mentions.text: Lynae, Rover, can you walk me through exactly how you managed to contain it?

mentions.title: At Dream's Edge
mentions.text: Lynae also reported seeing a graffiti-like image at the anomaly's center. But we still don't fully understand what happened. The investigation isn't over yet.

mentions.title: Ode to the Second Sunrise
mentions.text: Oh, but hey, you got Mornye's email about the Hyvatia Detector, right? It's almost go-time. How about we hang by the entrance, and then we—

mentions.title: What Burns Beneath Frostlands
mentions.text: The Fractsidus investigation is still dragging on. And since I'm technically not enrolled yet, no classes for me. Ugh... They even confiscated my ride, too. Professor Mornye dumped a ton of homework on me to keep me busy.

mentions.title: Starlights from Yesterdays
mentions.text: I kinda cornered Professor Mornye. Bugged her until she cracked.

mentions.title: At Dream's Edge
mentions.text: So... this is one of the Dream Band shards Professor Mornye mentioned?

voicelines.title: About Luuk Herssen
voicelines.text: The first time I met Dr. Herssen at the infirmary, I got this weird feeling he could see right through me. Now I think I might've just imagined it. Anyway, the man can write a very generous doctor's note slip. I'll give him that.

mentions.title: Starlights from Yesterdays
mentions.text: Candy? It's a new flavor. Sigrika and Lynae suggested it. Great for lifting spirits.

voicelines.title: About Chisa
voicelines.text: First time I saw Chisa, I thought that quiet, intense vibe meant "keep your distance." Man, was I wrong. We clicked instantly. She took one look at my bike and knew exactly what part was malfunctioning. Way faster than any manual diagnostic I could've run! Now that's impressive...

mentions.title: Gold Suspended in Shadows
mentions.text: Sigrika! Over here! Chisa's getting a new top record!

mentions.title: What Burns Beneath Frostlands
mentions.text: Unconventional methods, huh? That reminds me, just a few days ago, a student named Chisa appeared out of thin air in the middle of a class. Freaked everyone out.

mentions.title: Starlights from Yesterdays
mentions.text: Rover, I've been asking everyone. Even Lynae was being vague about it, but I figured it out…

mentions.text: Back then, Lynae had no idea whether Rover, who had literally fallen straight from the sky, had witnessed the exact moment she carried out her plan. So she reached out immediately, hauling Rover upright and dragging onto the back seat of her motorbike.

mentions.title: What Burns Beneath Frostlands
mentions.text: (Lynae's behavior is suspicious… but judging by what I just saw, she didn't seem like she was trying to damage the Detector.)

mentions.title: Starlights from Yesterdays
