voicelines.title: About Sigrika
voicelines.text: She's a remarkably conscientious student, but her persistence can sometimes be wasteful. For instance, she will fill the exam questions with unrelated formulas when she doesn't know the answers. It won't get her points.

mentions.title: Beneath a Melting Night Sky
mentions.text: Tonight might not work for me... I... I promised Professor Mornye I'd help out at the Reactor Drive today...

mentions.title: Gold Suspended in Shadows
mentions.text: Senior, Professor Mornye is calling.

mentions.title: Sunny Season
mentions.text: I've been helping Professor Mornye with the Reactor Drive for the past couple of days ... Feels like it's been ages since we met, Senior!

mentions.title: At Dream's Edge
mentions.text: We just finished the weapon's analysis. I've arranged for remote configuration. Lynae and Sigrika, your attacks should be effective now.

voicelines.title: About Luuk Herssen
voicelines.text: When I was a student, I frequented the infirmary. Dr. Herssen had me take a medicine imported from the New Federation that would only take effect if I went to bed before 10 P.M. A month passed, and my health improved. It wasn't until later that I found those medicines were just ordinary Lahai-Roi plant-based milk...

mentions.title: Ode to the Second Sunrise
mentions.text: We're still unsure what triggered the surge. But after comparing the waveforms with the device Professor Mornye brought back, we suspect it was an artificially induced Void Storm.

mentions.title: Starlights from Yesterdays
mentions.text: President Lucilla, Professor Mornye, and I have all put in a good word. You'll be meeting him at the Research Institute.

voicelines.title: About Chisa
voicelines.text: The freshman girl who vanished in the Void Storm... I remember the incident clearly. It happened during my first year as a teaching assistant at the Academy. I even graded a paper she submitted. It was exceptionally well-written, with a logical structure, rigorous analysis, and precise formatting. Now, she's become the student who writes the best papers in my class.

mentions.title: Starlights from Yesterdays
mentions.text: Rover, I'm at the Research Institute. Professor Mornye is here, too.

voicelines.title: About Yangyang
voicelines.text: That girl, I think the name is Yangyang. I hear her humming from time to time. Surprisingly, her melodies always bring my mind to peace.

mentions.title: First Resonance
mentions.text: This is Mortefi, a renowned figure in the Department of Safety. He was born in the New Federation, and he joined the Huaxu Academy a few years ago. I heard his talent is truly impressive.

mentions.title: Clashing Blades
mentions.text: Mr. Mortefi said it's an intricate puzzle box. Madam Magistrate might have hid her real message inside.

voicelines.title: About Chixia
voicelines.text: Speaking of Chixia, she's a regular visitor at my lab, often bringing children along. She's a straightforward person, which I like. Besides, those who get along with kids are never bad people. Kids are incredibly perceptive of a person's true character.

voicelines.title: About Xiangli Yao
voicelines.text: That Xiangli Yao... One day I'll outdo him, and create even better inventions!

voicelines.title: About Mortefi
voicelines.text: Mortefi is an interesting person. He's devoted to his work with unwavering determination. It's that kind of intense drive that pushes scientists towards brilliant discoveries. I know he considers me a "genius"—but in a workplace with only "geniuses", many ideas will never be realized. My dear friend has yet to grasp his true potential.

mentions.title: First Resonance
mentions.text: Crack that thing another five degrees, and not even Xiangli Yao will be able to save it.

mentions.text: Rover, how did you meet Abby?

mentions.title: Veils Off in Sun or Shadow
mentions.text: It's Phoebe! What's she doing here with all those Echoes?

mentions.title: What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing
mentions.text: I can't wait to explore! Oh, by the way, it's been a while since we last saw Zani and Phoebe. Wonder what they're up to right now...

mentions.text: It must be Miss Margherita's pizza cooked to perfection by Bakie...

mentions.text: Even before dinner time, Trattoria Margherita was already packed with eager diners.

voicelines.title: About Brant
voicelines.text: Mother once told me a story about an adventurer braving storms in search of freedom. When I saw Brant on stage, he reminded me of that adventurer, caring for naught while the ocean thrashes around him... Sometimes, I think Mr. Brant chooses to act out a life of equal parts comedy and tragedy.

voicelines.title: About Roccia
voicelines.text: Miss Roccia might appear ice cold, but at heart, I know she is a gentle and caring person. Her kindheartedness brings smiles to all those around her. And then there's her friend, Pero. I wonder if there's any chance Pero could also be my friend?

voicelines.title: About Phoebe
voicelines.text: She's from the Order of the Deep. I don't know her very well, but… she was the first Acolyte to touch the box without getting bitten by Pero.

bonds.label: Acquainted

voicelines.title: About Zani
voicelines.text: Not everyone in Ragunna worships the Sentinel. Certain Acolytes of the Order believe a person's worth is solely measured by their piety... But Miss Zani is brave and dependable, which just might be enough to overcome existing prejudices. After all, she's such a reliable and respectable person.

voicelines.title: About Phoebe
voicelines.text: To me, Ragunna's fate lies in the will of its people, not the Sentinel. Many Acolytes would call this heresy, but not Phoebe. That's what makes her unique. She would never dismiss another's beliefs or efforts just because they do not align with her own.

mentions.title: A Stranger in a Strange Land
mentions.text: Ms. Zani and I have been assessing the damage to Averardo Vault and the Cathedral of Mercury.

mentions.title: Ragunna Holiday
mentions.text: Haha, that sounds like something Zani would say. Thank you for comforting me, Rover. Now, let's move on.

mentions.title: The One that Impresses
mentions.text: Are you all right, Ms. Zani? This is too much! Mr. Abbowser promised me he would treat his employees better!

mentions.title: Veils Off in Sun or Shadow
mentions.text: I appreciate your passion for the Order, Miss Phoebe, but now is not the time. We need to uncover the real culprit behind the Fisalias.

mentions.title: What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing
mentions.text: Phoebe is stationed at the east plaza, keeping an eye on things.

voicelines.title: About Cristoforo
voicelines.text: Attempting to awaken true free will in mankind, one that dares to confront the very truths of this world is an intriguing pursuit. Pity that blind will, without the anchor of survival, becomes naught but a flash in the pan. Are not the uncontrollable turns and imperfect endings caught within the cracks of the script the very tolling of a warning bell?

mentions.title: What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing
mentions.text: Cristoforo, if you don't want to spoil the next act, I might have to give your carefully crafted plot a little nudge.

mentions.title: Flames of Heart
mentions.text: I don't care for your taste, Cristoforo.

mentions.title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
mentions.text: You lost the Gem I entrusted to you, Cristoforo.

mentions.title: Flames of Heart
mentions.text: Then so be it. You know, Phrolova, stories are but mankind's attempt to imagine and rehearse fate.

mentions.title: What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing
mentions.text: Phrolova, it seems we walk different paths. I don't share your fondness for that sort of... puppet theater.

mentions.title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
mentions.text: As you wish. My sincerest gratitude for your wonderful performance, Lady Phrolova. May you find the strength to create the Beyond you once envisioned.

voicelines.title: About Scar
voicelines.text: Madmen who don't play by the rules lack elegance. With but a breath, they undo even the most meticulous of plans. I care not for his true desires, only that he remain as far from me as fate will allow.

bonds.label: Acquainted

voicelines.title: About Cartethyia
voicelines.text: Not human, yet possessing a will whole as any mortal's. A creation molded by Divinity... how I envy her. If only I could unearth the universal truth behind her success, then perhaps the echoes from the other shore would sing even sweeter.

sceneQuests: What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing

voicelines.title: About Changli
voicelines.text: The flame she manipulates is indeed a rare and perilous force. My Quietude Art could only ease the burning pain it caused her. To avoid being consumed by it, she had to temper her mind and master the flow of her Forte. The life she had already burned away cannot be restored. But now that she can wield it freely, she should be fine, so long as she respects her limits. That, too, is thanks to you.

mentions.title: Song of the Heart Sword
mentions.text: Shortly after the Magistrate took office, Counselor Changli visited Xuanfang Hold for a Ministry of War conference on regional defense. That was where I first met her.

voicelines.title: About Yangyang
voicelines.text: When I first met her, I thought the Xuanling Bird had returned. She sees right through the ways of the world and hears the unspoken voices of others. Her Sword Intent seems gentle, yet it carries a resilience second to none. Something seems to be pressing behind her, urging her ever onward, toward some distant journey. Perhaps it is not that she resembles the Xuanling Bird... but that the Xuanling Bird resembled her.

mentions.title: Song of the Heart Sword
mentions.text: Suisui, I really am fine... Rover and Paragon Qingxiao are the ones who went into the Sanctum. They faced all the real danger.

mentions.title: Song of the Heart Sword
mentions.text: Then I will rely on you, Yangyang.

voicelines.title: About Buling
voicelines.text: That child is remarkably gifted and sharp. She has already mastered the basics of her Thunder Spells, though she rarely shows them off. At first, I tested her rigorously to see the true depths of her potential. Had she dedicated herself to her cultivation, she might well have reached her master's level within a few years. But that path is clearly not for her. The other day, she sent me a glowing knight's sword, calling it a travel souvenir from Rinascita. Well... at least she was thinking of me.

voicelines.title: About Sanhua
voicelines.text: My master once told me some of my ancestors moved from Chongzhou to the borderlands. Sanhua comes from that branch of lineage. Like me, her only interest used to be swordplay. But now, it seems she's found a purpose for her blade in Jinzhou's Magistrate. I'm glad for her.

voicelines.title: About Changli
voicelines.text: In Mingting, people like me rarely got the chance to meet the high-ups—and understandably so. We only show up where there's trouble. As for her, all I know is that ever since she stepped down as Secretary-General, no one's been able to truly fill her place.

voicelines.title: About Jiyan
voicelines.text: Across the troops under Huanglong's Ministry of War, you'd find no one other than him competent enough to earn the title of General at such a young age. I heard he used to be a medic before joining the Midnight Rangers... He's saving lives, one way or another.

mentions.title: A Stranger in a Strange Land
mentions.text: You know Jiyan. You fought in Norfall Barrens. You must also know what really happened in Jinzhou three years ago.

voicelines.title: About Scar
voicelines.text: My knowledge of him only comes from the files. If we ever crossed blades, he wouldn't last three rounds without backup. Though Mingting brushed him aside like any other Fractsidus criminal, people in Jinzhou would scour the earth for him. Given the gravity of his crime, he's only asking to meet his end.

mentions.title: Reforged
mentions.text: "Scar, the Fractsidus Overseer, escaped from Jinzhou's prison not long ago. Find out how Scar escaped, then head east to Rinascita."

mentions.title: A Stranger in a Strange Land
mentions.text: She asked me to execute a Fractsidus Overseer named Scar in Rinascita, and help Rover in the process.

mentions.title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
mentions.text: Prisoner Scar of Jinzhou. Surrender now. One strike is all it would take to end you. Surrender, and you may be spared pain.

voicelines.title: About Lynae
voicelines.text: Lynae and I just click. Got a lot in common—graffiti, motorbikes, badass vibes... Even went racin'. I ate her dust, but whatevs. Not many students 'round here are as nova as she is. Rare breed for sure. Be cool as hell if I got to be her classmate.

mentions.title: At Dream's Edge
mentions.text: C'mon, I'm sure Rebecca's already got a plan, right?

mentions.title: At Dream's Edge
mentions.text: Y'know, honestly...? Kinda like it here at the Academy. Could drag Sigrika and Lynae 'round to some classes, see what that's like.

voicelines.title: About Mornye
voicelines.text: Mornye's chrome legs and what I've got installed are toootally different. Hers are see-through! Can look right through 'em 'thout seein' a single wire or chip! Like, how's that even work? Uses 'em like she was born with 'em, like the kid's had 'em since forever—Wait, what...? She's OLDER than me?! The hell?!

mentions.title: At Dream's Edge
mentions.text: While we can't fully decode your power, we can study and replicate the frequency signatures of Lucy and Rebecca's weapons, applying it to our own armaments.

mentions.title: At Dream's Edge
mentions.text: Right, now that that's wrapped up, gotta go grab my iron from Mornye and meet up with Luce.

voicelines.title: About Luuk Herssen
voicelines.text: At first, he gave me creepy scavenger vibes. Boy, was I wrong. Hear he's good at patchin' peeps up, even their minds. Might let him scan my skull sponge when the dust settles. See if my grayware needs tuning, or if I'm just a certified whackjob.

mentions.title: At Dream's Edge
mentions.text: Of course. While you're at it, could you give Rebecca this Terminal?

voicelines.title: About Sigrika
voicelines.text: Sigrika's a good kid. Too good. Bein' that responsible, with everyone expectin' so much...? Gotta be exhaustin'. She oughta cut loose more. Go wild sometimes, y'know? ...Speakin' of, think she'd be down to hit the arcade with me next weekend?

mentions.text: I'm actually not very good at gaming. I lost every round until Rebecca showed up and gave me a hand.

mentions.text: Hm, guess I'm curious about your world, too, though. 'Specially the Echoes. Man, I'd kill to have an Echo buddy like Abby!

mentions.text: Got a feeling that even when we find Rebecca, she's not going for that check-up.

voicelines.text: Zani is the definition of a proper adult. Working with her is so easy, so comfortable, and I never have to worry about anything going wrong...

mentions.text: Childhood memories were hazy for Roccia, but as she followed Brant and the crew into Ragunna's streets, the familiar smell of Trattoria Margherita's fresh-baked pizza and the songs spilling from the Odyssey Opera House stirred something deep within her, just like it did everyone else.

mentions.text: When night falls, the curtain will rise at Margherita's Restauraunt.

voicelines.title: About Jianxin
voicelines.text: Jianxin... her soul has a beautiful golden hue, and she is a person of respectable character.

voicelines.title: About Lingyang
voicelines.text: That young liondancer? His soul appears in a unique shape, similar to that of an animal... I'm a little ashamed to admit that I once mistook him for a beast from the wild... Ahem. Don't worry, I have since made a formal apology to him, and we've cleared up the misunderstanding.

bonds.label: Know of each other

voicelines.title: About Baizhi
voicelines.text: Baizhi is a brilliant scholar. I once worked with her on a collaborative project, assigned by Madam Magistrate. She will no doubt become a prominent scholar at the Huaxu Academy, and eventually a significant contributor to the study of Remnant Ecoacoustics in Huanglong.

sceneQuests: Depths of Illusive Realm · event story

voicelines.title: About Aalto
voicelines.text: A mature organization requires a personable and skilled negotiator, adept at forging connections with all they encounter. In the case of the Black Shores, that person is Aalto. His keen insight ensures he obtains crucial information precisely when needed. Beneath his playful smile lies a resolute determination to end the Lament. Despite other offers, he was destined for the Black Shores' path from the start.

mentions.title: Hidden Between the Waves
mentions.text: In times of great adversity, the Shorekeeper will reveal herself and support our true leader, who, at the destined moment, will rise to save and guide the Black Shores. Fantastical or not, that's all we've got to go on.

mentions.title: We Choose the Sky
mentions.text: But... the Bloombearers who graduated from Startorch heard about this and stepped up to endorse Lucilla. That's what changed Shorekeeper's mind.

mentions.title: Through the Sea Thou Break
mentions.text: I'll have Aalto arrange your transportation to Rinascita then.

voicelines.title: About Encore
voicelines.text: Encore sees the world as a canvas for her boundless imagination. A warrior, a knight, or a little adventurer... In her tales, she can become anyone she wants to triumph over evil and reach a happy ending. Wherever she ventures, her radiant energy dispels dismay. Perhaps this is what Tethys saw in her when she was chosen.

mentions.title: The One that Impresses

voicelines.title: About Yangyang
voicelines.text: Since we were children, people have said that Yangyang and I share only a face, that our spirits couldn't be more different. I was the one who needed to see everything the world had to offer, while she was the quiet, gentle center who kept her thoughts close. Over time, people even joked, asking if we were truly sisters at all. Neither of us ever took offense. We knew that in all this wide world, you could never find two souls more alike. My sister may look soft and unassuming, but there is a resilience in her that runs deeper than anyone realizes. When you need the wind, she brings it to you. When you face the gale, she stands as your shield. This, I've always known.

voicelines.title: About Mother
voicelines.text: People know her as a master composer, but to me, she remains that gentle presence on the porch, pulling my sister and me into her arms on rainy days to tell us stories of the world beyond. I was always pressing her for what came next, while Yangyang would just watch her in quiet, wide-eyed wonder. Hehe, I suppose that was the rhythm of our childhood.
